dhp1-20_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp1:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp1:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 1–20 ",
  "dhp1:0.3": "1. Pairs ",
  "dhp1:0.4": "",
  "dhp1:1": "Intention is the leader of things; ",
  "dhp1:2": "intention is first, they’re made by intention. ",
  "dhp1:3": "If with corrupt intent ",
  "dhp1:4": "you speak or act, ",
  "dhp1:5": "suffering follows you, ",
  "dhp1:6": "like a wheel, the ox’s foot. ",
  "dhp2:0": "",
  "dhp2:1": "Intention is the leader of things; ",
  "dhp2:2": "intention is first, they’re made by intention. ",
  "dhp2:3": "If with pure intent ",
  "dhp2:4": "you speak or act, ",
  "dhp2:5": "happiness follows you ",
  "dhp2:6": "like a shadow that never leaves. ",
  "dhp3:0": "",
  "dhp3:1": "“They abused me, they hit me! ",
  "dhp3:2": "They beat me, they robbed me!” ",
  "dhp3:3": "For those who bear such a grudge, ",
  "dhp3:4": "hatred is never laid to rest. ",
  "dhp4:1": "“They abused me, they hit me! ",
  "dhp4:2": "They beat me, they robbed me!” ",
  "dhp4:3": "For those who bear no such grudge, ",
  "dhp4:4": "hatred is laid to rest. ",
  "dhp5:0": "",
  "dhp5:1": "For never is hatred ",
  "dhp5:2": "laid to rest by hate, ",
  "dhp5:3": "it’s laid to rest by love: ",
  "dhp5:4": "this is an ancient teaching. ",
  "dhp6:0": "",
  "dhp6:1": "When others do not understand, ",
  "dhp6:2": "let us, who do understand this, ",
  "dhp6:3": "restrain ourselves in this regard; ",
  "dhp6:4": "for that is how conflicts are laid to rest. ",
  "dhp7:0": "",
  "dhp7:1": "Those who contemplate the beautiful, ",
  "dhp7:2": "their faculties unrestrained, ",
  "dhp7:3": "immoderate in eating, ",
  "dhp7:4": "lazy, lacking energy: ",
  "dhp7:5": "Māra strikes them down ",
  "dhp7:6": "like the wind, a feeble tree. ",
  "dhp8:1": "Those who contemplate the ugly, ",
  "dhp8:2": "their faculties well-restrained, ",
  "dhp8:3": "eating in moderation, ",
  "dhp8:4": "faithful and energetic: ",
  "dhp8:5": "Māra cannot strike them down, ",
  "dhp8:6": "like the wind, a rocky mountain. ",
  "dhp9:0": "",
  "dhp9:1": "One who, not free of stains themselves, ",
  "dhp9:2": "would wear the robe stained in ocher, ",
  "dhp9:3": "bereft of self-control and truth: ",
  "dhp9:4": "they are not worthy of the ocher robe. ",
  "dhp10:1": "One who’s purged all their stains, ",
  "dhp10:2": "steady in ethics, ",
  "dhp10:3": "possessed of self-control and of truth, ",
  "dhp10:4": "they are truly worthy of the ocher robe. ",
  "dhp11:0": "",
  "dhp11:1": "Thinking the inessential is essential, ",
  "dhp11:2": "seeing the essential as inessential; ",
  "dhp11:3": "they don’t realize the essential, ",
  "dhp11:4": "for wrong thoughts are their habitat. ",
  "dhp12:1": "Having known the essential as essential, ",
  "dhp12:2": "and the inessential as inessential; ",
  "dhp12:3": "they realize the essential, ",
  "dhp12:4": "for right thoughts are their habitat. ",
  "dhp13:0": "",
  "dhp13:1": "Just as rain seeps into ",
  "dhp13:2": "a poorly roofed house, ",
  "dhp13:3": "lust seeps into ",
  "dhp13:4": "an undeveloped mind. ",
  "dhp14:1": "Just as rain doesn’t seep into ",
  "dhp14:2": "a well roofed house, ",
  "dhp14:3": "lust doesn’t seep into ",
  "dhp14:4": "a well developed mind. ",
  "dhp15:0": "",
  "dhp15:1": "Here they grieve, hereafter they grieve, ",
  "dhp15:2": "an evildoer grieves in both places. ",
  "dhp15:3": "They grieve and fret, ",
  "dhp15:4": "seeing their own corrupt deeds. ",
  "dhp16:0": "",
  "dhp16:1": "Here they rejoice, hereafter they rejoice, ",
  "dhp16:2": "one who does good rejoices in both places. ",
  "dhp16:3": "They rejoice and celebrate, ",
  "dhp16:4": "seeing their own pure deeds. ",
  "dhp17:0": "",
  "dhp17:1": "Here they’re tormented, <j>hereafter they’re tormented, ",
  "dhp17:2": "an evildoer is tormented in both places. ",
  "dhp17:3": "They’re tormented <j>thinking of bad things they’ve done; ",
  "dhp17:4": "when gone to a bad place, <j>they’re tormented all the more. ",
  "dhp18:0": "",
  "dhp18:1": "Here they delight, hereafter they delight, ",
  "dhp18:2": "one who does good delights in both places. ",
  "dhp18:3": "They delight thinking of good things they’ve done; ",
  "dhp18:4": "when gone to a good place, they delight all the more. ",
  "dhp19:0": "",
  "dhp19:1": "Much though they may recite scripture, ",
  "dhp19:2": "if a negligent person does not apply them, ",
  "dhp19:3": "then, like a cowherd who counts the cattle of others, ",
  "dhp19:4": "they miss out on the blessings of the ascetic life. ",
  "dhp20:1": "Little though they may recite scripture, ",
  "dhp20:2": "if they live in line with the teaching, ",
  "dhp20:3": "having given up greed, hate, and delusion, ",
  "dhp20:4": "with deep understanding and heart well freed, ",
  "dhp20:5": "not grasping to this life or the next, ",
  "dhp20:6": "they share in the blessings of the ascetic life. ",
  "dhp20:7": ""
}

dhp100-115_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp100:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp100:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 100–115 ",
  "dhp100:0.3": "8. The Thousands ",
  "dhp100:0.4": "",
  "dhp100:1": "Better than a thousand ",
  "dhp100:2": "meaningless sayings ",
  "dhp100:3": "is a single meaningful saying, ",
  "dhp100:4": "hearing which brings you peace. ",
  "dhp101:0": "",
  "dhp101:1": "Better than a thousand ",
  "dhp101:2": "meaningless verses ",
  "dhp101:3": "is a single meaningful verse, ",
  "dhp101:4": "hearing which brings you peace. ",
  "dhp102:0": "",
  "dhp102:1": "Better than reciting ",
  "dhp102:2": "a hundred meaningless verses ",
  "dhp102:3": "is a single saying of Dhamma, ",
  "dhp102:4": "hearing which brings you peace. ",
  "dhp103:1": "The supreme conqueror is ",
  "dhp103:2": "not he who conquers a million men in battle, ",
  "dhp103:3": "but he who conquers a single man: ",
  "dhp103:4": "himself. ",
  "dhp104:0": "",
  "dhp104:1": "It is surely better to conquer oneself ",
  "dhp104:2": "than all those other folk. ",
  "dhp104:3": "When a person has tamed themselves, ",
  "dhp104:4": "always living restrained, ",
  "dhp105:1": "no god nor centaur, ",
  "dhp105:2": "nor Māra nor divinity, ",
  "dhp105:3": "can undo the victory ",
  "dhp105:4": "of such a personage. ",
  "dhp106:0": "",
  "dhp106:1": "Rather than a thousandfold sacrifice, ",
  "dhp106:2": "every month for a full century, ",
  "dhp106:3": "it’s better to honor for a single hour ",
  "dhp106:4": "one who has developed themselves. ",
  "dhp106:5": "That offering is better ",
  "dhp106:6": "than the hundred year sacrifice. ",
  "dhp107:0": "",
  "dhp107:1": "Rather than serve the sacred flame ",
  "dhp107:2": "in the forest for a hundred years, ",
  "dhp107:3": "it’s better to honor for a single hour ",
  "dhp107:4": "a personage who has developed themselves. ",
  "dhp107:5": "That offering is better ",
  "dhp107:6": "than the hundred year sacrifice. ",
  "dhp108:0": "",
  "dhp108:1": "Whatever sacrifice or offering in the world ",
  "dhp108:2": "a seeker of merit may make for a year, ",
  "dhp108:3": "none of it is worth a quarter ",
  "dhp108:4": "of bowing to the sincere. ",
  "dhp109:0": "",
  "dhp109:1": "For one in the habit of bowing, ",
  "dhp109:2": "always honoring the elders, ",
  "dhp109:3": "four blessings grow: ",
  "dhp109:4": "lifespan, beauty, happiness, and strength. ",
  "dhp110:0": "",
  "dhp110:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp110:2": "ethical and absorbed in meditation ",
  "dhp110:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp110:4": "unethical and lacking immersion. ",
  "dhp111:0": "",
  "dhp111:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp111:2": "wise and absorbed in meditation ",
  "dhp111:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp111:4": "witless and lacking immersion. ",
  "dhp112:0": "",
  "dhp112:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp112:2": "energetic and strong, ",
  "dhp112:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp112:4": "lazy and lacking energy. ",
  "dhp113:0": "",
  "dhp113:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp113:2": "seeing rise and fall ",
  "dhp113:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp113:4": "blind to rise and fall. ",
  "dhp114:0": "",
  "dhp114:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp114:2": "seeing the state free of death ",
  "dhp114:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp114:4": "blind to the state free of death. ",
  "dhp115:0": "",
  "dhp115:1": "Better to live a single day ",
  "dhp115:2": "seeing the supreme teaching ",
  "dhp115:3": "than to live a hundred years ",
  "dhp115:4": "blind to the supreme teaching. ",
  "dhp115:5": ""
}

dhp116-128_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp116:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp116:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 116–128 ",
  "dhp116:0.3": "9. Wickedness ",
  "dhp116:0.4": "",
  "dhp116:1": "Rush to do good, ",
  "dhp116:2": "shield your mind from evil; ",
  "dhp116:3": "for when you’re slow to do good, ",
  "dhp116:4": "your thoughts delight in wickedness. ",
  "dhp117:0": "",
  "dhp117:1": "If you do something bad, ",
  "dhp117:2": "don’t do it again and again, ",
  "dhp117:3": "don’t set your heart on it, ",
  "dhp117:4": "for piling up evil is suffering. ",
  "dhp118:0": "",
  "dhp118:1": "If you do something good, ",
  "dhp118:2": "do it again and again, ",
  "dhp118:3": "set your heart on it, ",
  "dhp118:4": "for piling up goodness is joyful. ",
  "dhp119:0": "",
  "dhp119:1": "Even the wicked see good things, ",
  "dhp119:2": "so long as their wickedness has not ripened. ",
  "dhp119:3": "But as soon as that wickedness ripens, ",
  "dhp119:4": "then the wicked see wicked things. ",
  "dhp120:1": "Even the good see wicked things, ",
  "dhp120:2": "so long as their goodness has not ripened. ",
  "dhp120:3": "But as soon as that goodness ripens, ",
  "dhp120:4": "then the good see good things. ",
  "dhp121:0": "",
  "dhp121:1": "Think not lightly of evil, ",
  "dhp121:2": "that it won’t come back to you. ",
  "dhp121:3": "The pot is filled with water ",
  "dhp121:4": "falling drop by drop; ",
  "dhp121:5": "the fool is filled with wickedness ",
  "dhp121:6": "piled up bit by bit. ",
  "dhp122:0": "",
  "dhp122:1": "Think not lightly of goodness, ",
  "dhp122:2": "that it won’t come back to you. ",
  "dhp122:3": "The pot is filled with water ",
  "dhp122:4": "falling drop by drop; ",
  "dhp122:5": "the attentive one is filled with goodness ",
  "dhp122:6": "piled up bit by bit. ",
  "dhp123:0": "",
  "dhp123:1": "Avoid wickedness, ",
  "dhp123:2": "as a merchant with rich cargo and small escort ",
  "dhp123:3": "would avoid a dangerous road, ",
  "dhp123:4": "or one who loves life would avoid drinking poison. ",
  "dhp124:0": "",
  "dhp124:1": "You can carry poison in your hand ",
  "dhp124:2": "if it has no wound, ",
  "dhp124:3": "for poison does not infect without a wound; ",
  "dhp124:4": "nothing bad happens unless you do bad. ",
  "dhp125:0": "",
  "dhp125:1": "Whoever wrongs a man who has done no wrong, ",
  "dhp125:2": "a pure man who has not a blemish, ",
  "dhp125:3": "the evil backfires on the fool, ",
  "dhp125:4": "like fine dust thrown upwind. ",
  "dhp126:0": "",
  "dhp126:1": "Some are born in a womb; ",
  "dhp126:2": "evildoers go to hell; ",
  "dhp126:3": "the virtuous go to heaven; ",
  "dhp126:4": "the undefiled are fully extinguished. ",
  "dhp127:0": "",
  "dhp127:1": "Not in midair, nor mid-ocean, ",
  "dhp127:2": "nor hiding in a mountain cleft; ",
  "dhp127:3": "you’ll find no place on the planet ",
  "dhp127:4": "to escape your wicked deeds. ",
  "dhp128:0": "",
  "dhp128:1": "Not in midair, nor mid-ocean, ",
  "dhp128:2": "nor hiding in a mountain cleft; ",
  "dhp128:3": "you’ll find no place on the planet ",
  "dhp128:4": "where you won’t be vanquished by death. ",
  "dhp128:5": ""
}

dhp129-145_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp129:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp129:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 129–145 ",
  "dhp129:0.3": "10. The Rod ",
  "dhp129:0.4": "",
  "dhp129:1": "All tremble at the rod, ",
  "dhp129:2": "all fear death. ",
  "dhp129:3": "Treating others like oneself, ",
  "dhp129:4": "neither kill nor incite to kill. ",
  "dhp130:0": "",
  "dhp130:1": "All tremble at the rod, ",
  "dhp130:2": "all love life. ",
  "dhp130:3": "Treating others like oneself, ",
  "dhp130:4": "neither kill nor incite to kill. ",
  "dhp131:0": "",
  "dhp131:1": "Creatures love happiness, ",
  "dhp131:2": "so if you harm them with a stick ",
  "dhp131:3": "in search of your own happiness, ",
  "dhp131:4": "after death you won’t find happiness. ",
  "dhp132:1": "Creatures love happiness, ",
  "dhp132:2": "so if you don’t harm them with a stick ",
  "dhp132:3": "in search of your own happiness, ",
  "dhp132:4": "after death you will find happiness. ",
  "dhp133:0": "",
  "dhp133:1": "Don’t speak harshly, ",
  "dhp133:2": "they may speak harshly back. ",
  "dhp133:3": "For aggressive speech is painful, ",
  "dhp133:4": "and the rod may spring back on you. ",
  "dhp134:1": "If you still yourself ",
  "dhp134:2": "like a broken gong, ",
  "dhp134:3": "you reach extinguishment ",
  "dhp134:4": "and know no conflict. ",
  "dhp135:0": "",
  "dhp135:1": "As a cowherd drives the cows ",
  "dhp135:2": "to pasture with the rod, ",
  "dhp135:3": "so too old age and death ",
  "dhp135:4": "drive life from living beings. ",
  "dhp136:0": "",
  "dhp136:1": "The fool does not understand ",
  "dhp136:2": "the evil that they do. ",
  "dhp136:3": "But because of those deeds, that simpleton ",
  "dhp136:4": "is tormented as if burnt by fire. ",
  "dhp137:0": "",
  "dhp137:1": "One who violently attacks ",
  "dhp137:2": "the peaceful and the innocent ",
  "dhp137:3": "swiftly falls ",
  "dhp137:4": "to one of ten bad states: ",
  "dhp138:1": "harsh pain; loss; ",
  "dhp138:2": "the breakup of the body; ",
  "dhp138:3": "serious illness; ",
  "dhp138:4": "mental distress; ",
  "dhp139:1": "hazards from rulers; ",
  "dhp139:2": "vicious slander; ",
  "dhp139:3": "loss of kin; ",
  "dhp139:4": "destruction of wealth; ",
  "dhp140:1": "or else their home ",
  "dhp140:2": "is consumed by fire. ",
  "dhp140:3": "When their body breaks up, that witless person ",
  "dhp140:4": "is reborn in hell. ",
  "dhp141:0": "",
  "dhp141:1": "Not nudity, nor matted hair, nor mud, ",
  "dhp141:2": "nor fasting, nor lying on bare ground, ",
  "dhp141:3": "nor wearing dust and dirt, or squatting on the heels, ",
  "dhp141:4": "will cleanse a mortal not free of doubt. ",
  "dhp142:0": "",
  "dhp142:1": "Dressed up they may be, but if they live well—",
  "dhp142:2": "peaceful, tamed, committed to the spiritual path, ",
  "dhp142:3": "having laid aside violence toward all creatures—",
  "dhp142:4": "they are a brahmin, an ascetic, a mendicant. ",
  "dhp143:0": "",
  "dhp143:1": "Can a person constrained by conscience ",
  "dhp143:2": "be found in the world? ",
  "dhp143:3": "Who shies away from blame, ",
  "dhp143:4": "like a fine horse from the whip? ",
  "dhp144:1": "Like a fine horse under the whip, ",
  "dhp144:2": "be keen and full of urgency. ",
  "dhp144:3": "With faith, ethics, and energy, ",
  "dhp144:4": "immersion, and investigation of principles, ",
  "dhp144:5": "accomplished in knowledge and conduct, mindful, ",
  "dhp144:6": "give up this vast suffering. ",
  "dhp145:0": "",
  "dhp145:1": "While irrigators guide water, ",
  "dhp145:2": "fletchers bend arrows straight, ",
  "dhp145:3": "and carpenters bend timber straight, ",
  "dhp145:4": "those true to their vows tame themselves. ",
  "dhp145:5": ""
}

dhp146-156_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp146:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp146:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 146–156 ",
  "dhp146:0.3": "11. Old Age ",
  "dhp146:0.4": "",
  "dhp146:1": "What is joy, what is laughter, ",
  "dhp146:2": "when the flames are ever burning? ",
  "dhp146:3": "Swathed in darkness, ",
  "dhp146:4": "would you not seek a light? ",
  "dhp147:0": "",
  "dhp147:1": "See this fancy puppet, ",
  "dhp147:2": "a body built of sores, ",
  "dhp147:3": "diseased, obsessed over, ",
  "dhp147:4": "in which nothing lasts at all. ",
  "dhp148:0": "",
  "dhp148:1": "This body is decrepit and frail, ",
  "dhp148:2": "a nest of disease. ",
  "dhp148:3": "This foul carcass falls apart, ",
  "dhp148:4": "for life ends in death. ",
  "dhp149:0": "",
  "dhp149:1": "These dove-grey bones ",
  "dhp149:2": "are tossed away like ",
  "dhp149:3": "dried gourds in the autumn—",
  "dhp149:4": "what joy is there in such a sight? ",
  "dhp150:0": "",
  "dhp150:1": "In this city built of bones, ",
  "dhp150:2": "plastered with flesh and blood, ",
  "dhp150:3": "old age and death are stashed away, ",
  "dhp150:4": "along with conceit and contempt. ",
  "dhp151:0": "",
  "dhp151:1": "Fancy chariots of kings wear out, ",
  "dhp151:2": "and even this body gets old. ",
  "dhp151:3": "But the truth of the good never gets old—",
  "dhp151:4": "so the good proclaim to the good. ",
  "dhp152:0": "",
  "dhp152:1": "A person of little learning ",
  "dhp152:2": "ages like an ox—",
  "dhp152:3": "their flesh grows, ",
  "dhp152:4": "but not their wisdom. ",
  "dhp153:0": "",
  "dhp153:1": "Transmigrating through countless rebirths, ",
  "dhp153:2": "I’ve journeyed without reward, ",
  "dhp153:3": "searching for the house-builder; ",
  "dhp153:4": "painful is birth again and again. ",
  "dhp154:1": "I’ve seen you, house-builder! ",
  "dhp154:2": "You won’t build a house again! ",
  "dhp154:3": "Your rafters are all broken, ",
  "dhp154:4": "your roof-peak demolished. ",
  "dhp154:5": "The mind, set on demolition, ",
  "dhp154:6": "has reached the end of cravings. ",
  "dhp155:0": "",
  "dhp155:1": "When young they spurned the spiritual path ",
  "dhp155:2": "and failed to earn any wealth. ",
  "dhp155:3": "Now they brood like old cranes ",
  "dhp155:4": "in a pond bereft of fish. ",
  "dhp156:1": "When young they spurned the spiritual path ",
  "dhp156:2": "and failed to earn any wealth. ",
  "dhp156:3": "Now they lie like spent arrows, ",
  "dhp156:4": "bemoaning over things past. ",
  "dhp156:5": ""
}

dhp157-166_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp157:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp157:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 157–166 ",
  "dhp157:0.3": "12. The Self ",
  "dhp157:0.4": "",
  "dhp157:1": "If you knew your self as beloved, ",
  "dhp157:2": "you’d look after it so well. ",
  "dhp157:3": "In one of the night’s three watches, ",
  "dhp157:4": "an astute person would remain alert. ",
  "dhp158:0": "",
  "dhp158:1": "The astute would avoid being corrupted ",
  "dhp158:2": "by first grounding themselves ",
  "dhp158:3": "in what is suitable, ",
  "dhp158:4": "and then instructing others. ",
  "dhp159:0": "",
  "dhp159:1": "If one were to treat oneself ",
  "dhp159:2": "as one instructs another, ",
  "dhp159:3": "the well-tamed indeed would tame: ",
  "dhp159:4": "for the self, it seems, is hard to tame. ",
  "dhp160:0": "",
  "dhp160:1": "One is indeed the lord of oneself, ",
  "dhp160:2": "for who else would be one’s lord? ",
  "dhp160:3": "By means of a well-tamed self, ",
  "dhp160:4": "one gains a lord that’s rare indeed. ",
  "dhp161:0": "",
  "dhp161:1": "For the evil that is done by oneself, ",
  "dhp161:2": "born and produced in oneself, ",
  "dhp161:3": "grinds down a simpleton, ",
  "dhp161:4": "as diamond grinds a lesser gem. ",
  "dhp162:0": "",
  "dhp162:1": "One choked by immorality, ",
  "dhp162:2": "as a sal tree by a creeper, ",
  "dhp162:3": "does to themselves ",
  "dhp162:4": "what a foe only wishes. ",
  "dhp163:0": "",
  "dhp163:1": "It’s easy to do bad things ",

  "dhp164:0": "",

  "dhp165:0": "",

dhp167-178_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp167:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp167:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 167–178 ",
  "dhp167:0.3": "13. The World ",
  "dhp167:0.4": "",
  "dhp167:1": "Don’t resort to lowly things, ",
  "dhp167:2": "don’t abide in negligence, ",

  "dhp168:0": "",
  "dhp168:1": "Get up, don’t be heedless, ",

  "dhp173:0": "",

dhp179-196_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp179:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp179:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 179–196 ",
  "dhp179:0.3": "14. The Buddhas ",
  "dhp179:0.4": "",
  "dhp179:1": "He whose victory may not be undone, ",
  "dhp179:2": "a victory unrivaled in all the world; ",
  "dhp179:3": "by what track would you trace that Buddha, ",
  "dhp179:4": "who leaves no track in his infinite range? ",
  "dhp180:1": "Of craving, the weaver, the clinger, he has none: ",
  "dhp180:2": "so where can he be traced? ",
  "dhp180:3": "By what track would you trace that Buddha, ",
  "dhp180:4": "who leaves no track in his infinite range? ",
  "dhp181:0": "",
  "dhp181:1": "The attentive intent on absorption, ",
  "dhp181:2": "who love the peace of renunciation, ",
  "dhp181:3": "the Buddhas, ever mindful, ",
  "dhp181:4": "are envied by even the gods. ",
  "dhp182:0": "",
  "dhp182:1": "It’s hard to gain a human birth; ",
  "dhp182:2": "the life of mortals is hard; ",
  "dhp182:3": "it’s hard to hear the true teaching; ",
  "dhp182:4": "the arising of Buddhas is hard. ",
  "dhp183:0": "",
  "dhp183:1": "Not to do any evil; ",
  "dhp183:2": "to embrace the good; ",
  "dhp183:3": "to purify one’s mind: ",
  "dhp183:4": "this is the instruction of the Buddhas. ",
  "dhp184:1": "Patient acceptance is the ultimate fervor. ",
  "dhp184:2": "Extinguishment is the ultimate, say the Buddhas. ",
  "dhp184:3": "No true renunciate injures another, ",
  "dhp184:4": "nor does an ascetic hurt another. ",
  "dhp185:1": "Not speaking ill nor doing harm; ",
  "dhp185:2": "restraint in the monastic code; ",
  "dhp185:3": "moderation in eating; ",
  "dhp185:4": "staying in remote lodgings; ",
  "dhp185:5": "commitment to the higher mind—",
  "dhp185:6": "this is the instruction of the Buddhas. ",
  "dhp186:0": "",
  "dhp186:1": "Even if it were raining money, ",
  "dhp186:2": "you’d not be sated in sensual pleasures. ",
  "dhp186:3": "An astute person understands that sensual pleasures ",
  "dhp186:4": "offer little gratification and much suffering. ",
  "dhp187:1": "Thus they find no delight ",
  "dhp187:2": "even in celestial pleasures. ",
  "dhp187:3": "A disciple of the fully awakened Buddha ",
  "dhp187:4": "delights in the ending of craving. ",
  "dhp188:0": "",
  "dhp188:1": "So many go for refuge ",
  "dhp188:2": "to mountains and forest groves, ",
  "dhp188:3": "to shrines in tended parks; ",
  "dhp188:4": "those people are driven by fear. ",
  "dhp189:1": "But such refuge is no sanctuary, ",
  "dhp189:2": "it is no supreme refuge. ",
  "dhp189:3": "By going to that refuge, ",
  "dhp189:4": "you’re not released from all suffering. ",
  "dhp190:1": "One gone for refuge to the Buddha, ",
  "dhp190:2": "to his teaching and to the Saṅgha, ",
  "dhp190:3": "sees the four noble truths ",
  "dhp190:4": "with right understanding: ",
  "dhp191:1": "suffering, suffering’s origin, ",
  "dhp191:2": "suffering’s transcendence, ",
  "dhp191:3": "and the noble eightfold path ",
  "dhp191:4": "that leads to the stilling of suffering. ",
  "dhp192:1": "Such refuge is a sanctuary, ",
  "dhp192:2": "it is the supreme refuge. ",
  "dhp192:3": "By going to that refuge, ",
  "dhp192:4": "you’re released from all suffering. ",
  "dhp193:0": "",
  "dhp193:1": "It’s hard to find a thoroughbred man: ",
  "dhp193:2": "they’re not born just anywhere. ",
  "dhp193:3": "A family where that attentive one is born ",
  "dhp193:4": "prospers in happiness. ",
  "dhp194:0": "",
  "dhp194:1": "Happy, the arising of Buddhas! ",
  "dhp194:2": "Happy, the teaching of Dhamma! ",
  "dhp194:3": "Happy is the harmony of the Saṅgha, ",
  "dhp194:4": "and the striving of the harmonious is happy. ",
  "dhp195:0": "",
  "dhp195:1": "When a person venerates the worthy—",
  "dhp195:2": "the Buddha or his disciple, ",
  "dhp195:3": "who have transcended proliferation, ",
  "dhp195:4": "and have left behind grief and lamentation, ",
  "dhp196:1": "quenched, fearing nothing from any quarter—",
  "dhp196:2": "the merit of one venerating such as these, ",
  "dhp196:3": "cannot be calculated by anyone, ",
  "dhp196:4": "saying it is just this much. ",
  "dhp196:5": "",
  "dhp196:6": ""

dhp197-208_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp197:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp197:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 197–208 ",
  "dhp197:0.3": "15. Happiness ",
  "dhp197:0.4": "",
  "dhp197:1": "Let us live so very happily, ",
  "dhp197:2": "loving among the hostile. ",
  "dhp197:3": "Among hostile humans, ",
  "dhp197:4": "let us live with love. ",
  "dhp198:1": "Let us live so very happily, ",
  "dhp198:2": "healthy among the ailing. ",
  "dhp198:3": "Among ailing humans ",
  "dhp198:4": "let us live healthily. ",
  "dhp199:1": "Let us live so very happily, ",
  "dhp199:2": "content among the greedy. ",
  "dhp199:3": "Among greedy humans, ",
  "dhp199:4": "let us live content. ",
  "dhp200:0": "",
  "dhp200:1": "Let us live so very happily, ",
  "dhp200:2": "we who have nothing. ",
  "dhp200:3": "We shall feed on rapture, ",
  "dhp200:4": "like the gods of sublime luminosity. ",
  "dhp201:0": "",
  "dhp201:1": "Victory breeds enmity; ",
  "dhp201:2": "the defeated sleep badly. ",
  "dhp201:3": "The peaceful sleep at ease, ",
  "dhp201:4": "having left victory and defeat behind. ",
  "dhp202:0": "",
  "dhp202:1": "There is no fire like greed, ",
  "dhp202:2": "no crime like hate, ",
  "dhp202:3": "no suffering like the aggregates, ",
  "dhp202:4": "no bliss beyond peace. ",
  "dhp203:0": "",
  "dhp203:1": "Hunger is the worst illness, ",
  "dhp203:2": "conditions are the worst suffering. ",
  "dhp203:3": "When one has known this as it is, ",
  "dhp203:4": "extinguishment is the ultimate happiness. ",
  "dhp204:0": "",
  "dhp204:1": "Health is the ultimate blessing; ",
  "dhp204:2": "contentment, the ultimate wealth; ",
  "dhp204:3": "trust is the ultimate family; ",
  "dhp204:4": "extinguishment, the ultimate happiness. ",
  "dhp205:0": "",
  "dhp205:1": "Having drunk the nectar of seclusion ",
  "dhp205:2": "and the nectar of peace—",
  "dhp205:3": "free of stress, free of evil, ",
  "dhp205:4": "drink the joyous nectar of truth. ",
  "dhp206:0": "",
  "dhp206:1": "It’s good to see the noble ones, ",
  "dhp206:2": "staying with them is always good. ",
  "dhp206:3": "Were you not to see fools, ",
  "dhp206:4": "you’d always be happy. ",
  "dhp207:1": "For one who consorts with fools ",
  "dhp207:2": "grieves long. ",
  "dhp207:3": "Painful is living with fools, ",
  "dhp207:4": "like being stuck with your enemy. ",
  "dhp207:5": "Happy is living with an attentive one, ",
  "dhp207:6": "like meeting with your kin. ",
  "dhp208:1": "Therefore: ",
  "dhp208:2": "An attentive one, wise and learned, ",
  "dhp208:3": "a behemoth of virtue, true to their vows, noble: ",
  "dhp208:4": "follow a true and intelligent person such as this, ",
  "dhp208:5": "as the moon tracks the path of the stars. ",
  "dhp208:6": ""
}

dhp209-220_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp209:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp209:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 209–220 ",
  "dhp209:0.3": "16. The Beloved ",
  "dhp209:0.4": "",
  "dhp209:1": "Applying yourself where you ought not, ",
  "dhp209:2": "neglecting what you should be doing, ",
  "dhp209:3": "forgetting your goal, you cling to what you hold dear, ",

  "dhp210:1": "Don’t ever get too close ",

  "dhp211:3": "No ties are found in they who ",

  "dhp212:0": "",

  "dhp214:4": "has no sorrow, let alone fear. ",
  "dhp215:0": "",

  "dhp216:1": "Sorrow springs from craving, ",

  "dhp217:0": "",
  "dhp217:1": "One accomplished in virtue and vision, ",

dhp21-32_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp21:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp21:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 21–32 ",
  "dhp21:0.3": "2. Diligence ",
  "dhp21:0.4": "",
  "dhp21:1": "Heedfulness is the state free of death; ",
  "dhp21:2": "heedlessness is the state of death. ",
  "dhp21:3": "The heedful do not die, ",
  "dhp21:4": "while the heedless are like the dead. ",
  "dhp22:1": "Understanding this distinction ",
  "dhp22:2": "when it comes to heedfulness, ",
  "dhp22:3": "the astute rejoice in heedfulness, ",
  "dhp22:4": "happy in the noble ones’ domain. ",
  "dhp23:1": "They who regularly meditate, ",
  "dhp23:2": "always staunchly vigorous; ",
  "dhp23:3": "the attentive realize extinguishment, ",
  "dhp23:4": "the supreme sanctuary from the yoke. ",
  "dhp24:0": "",
  "dhp24:1": "For the hard-working and mindful, ",
  "dhp24:2": "pure of deed and attentive, ",
  "dhp24:3": "restrained, living righteously, and diligent, ",
  "dhp24:4": "their reputation only grows. ",
  "dhp25:0": "",
  "dhp25:1": "By hard work and diligence, ",
  "dhp25:2": "by restraint and by self-control, ",
  "dhp25:3": "a smart person would build an island ",
  "dhp25:4": "that the floods cannot overflow. ",
  "dhp26:0": "",
  "dhp26:1": "Fools and simpletons ",
  "dhp26:2": "devote themselves to negligence. ",
  "dhp26:3": "But the wise protect diligence ",
  "dhp26:4": "as their best treasure. ",
  "dhp27:1": "Don’t devote yourself to negligence, ",
  "dhp27:2": "or delight in erotic intimacy. ",
  "dhp27:3": "For if you’re diligent and meditate, ",
  "dhp27:4": "you’ll attain abundant happiness. ",
  "dhp28:0": "",
  "dhp28:1": "When the astute dispel negligence ",
  "dhp28:2": "by means of diligence, ",
  "dhp28:3": "ascending the palace of wisdom, ",
  "dhp28:4": "sorrowless, they behold this generation of sorrow, ",
  "dhp28:5": "as an attentive one on a mountain top ",
  "dhp28:6": "beholds the fools below. ",
  "dhp29:0": "",
  "dhp29:1": "Heedful among the heedless, ",
  "dhp29:2": "wide awake while others sleep—",
  "dhp29:3": "a true sage leaves them behind, ",
  "dhp29:4": "like a swift horse passing a feeble. ",
  "dhp30:0": "",
  "dhp30:1": "Maghavā became chief of the gods ",
  "dhp30:2": "by means of diligence. ",
  "dhp30:3": "People praise diligence, ",
  "dhp30:4": "while negligence is always deplored. ",
  "dhp31:0": "",
  "dhp31:1": "A mendicant who loves diligence, ",
  "dhp31:2": "seeing fear in negligence—",
  "dhp31:3": "advances like fire, ",
  "dhp31:4": "burning up fetters big and small. ",
  "dhp32:0": "",
  "dhp32:1": "A mendicant who loves diligence, ",
  "dhp32:2": "seeing fear in negligence—",
  "dhp32:3": "such a one can’t decline, ",
  "dhp32:4": "and has drawn near to extinguishment. ",
  "dhp32:5": ""
}

dhp221-234_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp221:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp221:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 221–234 ",
  "dhp221:0.3": "17. Anger ",
  "dhp221:0.4": "",
  "dhp221:1": "Give up anger, get rid of conceit, ",
  "dhp221:2": "and escape every fetter. ",
  "dhp221:3": "Sufferings don’t befall one who has nothing, ",
  "dhp221:4": "not clinging to name and form. ",
  "dhp222:0": "",
  "dhp222:1": "When anger surges like a lurching chariot, ",
  "dhp222:2": "keep it in check. ",
  "dhp222:3": "That’s what I call a charioteer; ",
  "dhp222:4": "others just hold the reins. ",
  "dhp223:0": "",
  "dhp223:1": "Defeat anger with kindness, ",
  "dhp223:2": "villainy with virtue, ",
  "dhp223:3": "stinginess with giving, ",
  "dhp223:4": "and lies with truth. ",
  "dhp224:0": "",
  "dhp224:1": "Speak the truth, do not be angry, ",
  "dhp224:2": "and give when asked, if only a little. ",
  "dhp224:3": "By these three means, ",
  "dhp224:4": "you may enter the presence of the gods. ",
  "dhp225:0": "",
  "dhp225:1": "Those harmless sages, ",
  "dhp225:2": "always restrained in body, ",

  "dhp226:0": "",
  "dhp226:1": "Always wakeful, ",
  "dhp226:2": "practicing night and day, ",

  "dhp226:4": "their defilements come to an end. ",
  "dhp227:0": "",
  "dhp227:1": "It’s always been this way, Atula, ",

  "dhp228:1": "There never was, nor will be, ",

  "dhp228:3": "someone who is wholly praised ",
  "dhp228:4": "or wholly blamed. ",

  "dhp231:0": "",
  "dhp231:1": "Guard against ill-tempered deeds, ",
  "dhp231:2": "be restrained in body. ",
  "dhp231:3": "Giving up bad bodily conduct, ",

  "dhp232:2": "be restrained in speech. ",
  "dhp232:3": "Giving up bad verbal conduct, ",
  "dhp232:4": "conduct yourself well in speech. ",

  "dhp233:3": "Giving up bad mental conduct, ",
  "dhp233:4": "conduct yourself well in mind. ",

dhp235-255_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp235:0.1": "Minor Collection ",

  "dhp235:0.3": "18. Stains ",
  "dhp235:0.4": "",
  "dhp235:1": "Today you’re like a withered leaf, ",
  "dhp235:2": "Yama’s men await you. ",
  "dhp235:3": "You stand at the departure gates, ",
  "dhp235:4": "yet you have no supplies for the road. ",
  "dhp236:1": "Make an island of yourself! ",
  "dhp236:2": "Swiftly strive, learn to be wise! ",
  "dhp236:3": "Purged of stains, flawless, ",
  "dhp236:4": "you’ll go to the heavenly realm of the noble ones. ",
  "dhp237:1": "You’ve journeyed the stages of life, ",
  "dhp237:2": "and now you set out to meet Yama. ",
  "dhp237:3": "Along the way there’s nowhere to stay, ",
  "dhp237:4": "yet you have no supplies for the road. ",
  "dhp238:1": "Make an island of yourself! ",
  "dhp238:2": "Swiftly strive, learn to be wise! ",
  "dhp238:3": "Purged of stains, flawless, ",
  "dhp238:4": "you’ll not come again to rebirth and old age. ",
  "dhp239:0": "",
  "dhp239:1": "A smart person would purge ",
  "dhp239:2": "their own stains gradually, ",
  "dhp239:3": "bit by bit, moment by moment, ",
  "dhp239:4": "like a smith smelting silver. ",
  "dhp240:0": "",
  "dhp240:1": "It is the rust born on the iron ",
  "dhp240:2": "that eats away the place it arose. ",
  "dhp240:3": "And so it is their own deeds ",
  "dhp240:4": "that lead the overly-ascetic to a bad place. ",
  "dhp241:0": "",
  "dhp241:1": "Not rehearsing is the stain of hymns. ",
  "dhp241:2": "The stain of houses is neglect. ",
  "dhp241:3": "Laziness is the stain of beauty. ",
  "dhp241:4": "A guard’s stain is negligence. ",
  "dhp242:0": "",
  "dhp242:1": "Misconduct is a woman’s stain. ",
  "dhp242:2": "A giver’s stain is stinginess. ",
  "dhp242:3": "Bad qualities are a stain ",
  "dhp242:4": "in this world and the next. ",
  "dhp243:1": "But a worse stain than these ",
  "dhp243:2": "is ignorance, the worst stain of all. ",
  "dhp243:3": "Having given up that stain, ",
  "dhp243:4": "be without stains, mendicants! ",
  "dhp244:0": "",
  "dhp244:1": "Life is easy for the shameless. ",
  "dhp244:2": "With all the rude courage of a crow, ",
  "dhp244:3": "they live pushy, ",
  "dhp244:4": "rude, and corrupt. ",
  "dhp245:1": "Life is hard for the conscientious, ",
  "dhp245:2": "always seeking purity, ",
  "dhp245:3": "neither clinging nor rude, ",
  "dhp245:4": "pure of livelihood and discerning. ",
  "dhp246:0": "",
  "dhp246:1": "Take anyone in this world ",
  "dhp246:2": "who kills living creatures, ",
  "dhp246:3": "speaks falsely, steals, ",
  "dhp246:4": "commits adultery, ",
  "dhp247:1": "and indulges in drinking ",
  "dhp247:2": "beer and wine. ",
  "dhp247:3": "Right here they dig up ",
  "dhp247:4": "the root of their own self. ",
  "dhp248:1": "Know this, my man: ",
  "dhp248:2": "they are unrestrained and wicked. ",
  "dhp248:3": "Don’t let that greed and unrighteousness ",
  "dhp248:4": "inflict pain on you for long. ",
  "dhp249:0": "",
  "dhp249:1": "The people give according to their faith, ",
  "dhp249:2": "according to their confidence. ",
  "dhp249:3": "If you get upset over that, ",
  "dhp249:4": "over others’ food and drink, ",
  "dhp249:5": "you’ll not, by day or by night, ",
  "dhp249:6": "become immersed in samādhi. ",
  "dhp250:1": "Those who have cut that out, ",
  "dhp250:2": "dug it up at the root, eradicated it, ",
  "dhp250:3": "they will, by day or by night, ",
  "dhp250:4": "become immersed in samādhi. ",
  "dhp251:0": "",
  "dhp251:1": "There is no fire like greed, ",
  "dhp251:2": "no crime like hate, ",
  "dhp251:3": "no net like delusion, ",
  "dhp251:4": "no river like craving. ",
  "dhp252:0": "",
  "dhp252:1": "It’s easy to see the faults of others, ",
  "dhp252:2": "hard to see one’s own. ",
  "dhp252:3": "For the faults of others ",
  "dhp252:4": "are tossed high like hay, ",
  "dhp252:5": "while one’s own are hidden, ",
  "dhp252:6": "as a cheat hides a bad hand. ",
  "dhp253:0": "",
  "dhp253:1": "When you look for the flaws of others, ",
  "dhp253:2": "always finding fault, ",
  "dhp253:3": "your defilements only grow, ",
  "dhp253:4": "you’re far from ending defilements. ",
  "dhp254:0": "",
  "dhp254:1": "In the atmosphere there is no track, ",
  "dhp254:2": "there’s no true ascetic outside here. ",
  "dhp254:3": "People enjoy proliferation, ",
  "dhp254:4": "the Realized Ones are free of proliferation. ",
  "dhp255:1": "In the atmosphere there is no track, ",
  "dhp255:2": "there’s no true ascetic outside here. ",
  "dhp255:3": "No conditions last forever, ",
  "dhp255:4": "the Awakened Ones are not shaken. ",
  "dhp255:5": ""
}

dhp256-272_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp256:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp256:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 256–272 ",
  "dhp256:0.3": "19. The Just ",
  "dhp256:0.4": "",
  "dhp256:1": "You don’t become just ",
  "dhp256:2": "by passing hasty judgment. ",
  "dhp256:3": "An astute person evaluates both ",
  "dhp256:4": "what is pertinent and what is irrelevant. ",
  "dhp257:1": "A wise one judges others without haste, ",
  "dhp257:2": "justly and impartially; ",
  "dhp257:3": "that guardian of the law ",
  "dhp257:4": "is said to be just. ",
  "dhp258:0": "",
  "dhp258:1": "You’re not an astute scholar ",
  "dhp258:2": "just because you speak a lot. ",
  "dhp258:3": "One who is secure, free of enmity and fear, ",
  "dhp258:4": "is said to be astute. ",
  "dhp259:0": "",
  "dhp259:1": "You’re not one who has memorized the teaching ",
  "dhp259:2": "just because you recite a lot. ",
  "dhp259:3": "Someone who directly sees the teaching ",
  "dhp259:4": "after hearing only a little ",
  "dhp259:5": "is truly one who has memorized the teaching, ",
  "dhp259:6": "for they can never forget it. ",
  "dhp260:0": "",
  "dhp260:1": "You don’t become a senior ",
  "dhp260:2": "by getting some grey hairs; ",
  "dhp260:3": "for one ripe only in age, ",
  "dhp260:4": "is said to have aged in vain. ",
  "dhp261:1": "One who is truthful and principled, ",
  "dhp261:2": "harmless, restrained, and self-controlled, ",
  "dhp261:3": "attentive, purged of stains, ",
  "dhp261:4": "is said to be a senior. ",
  "dhp262:0": "",
  "dhp262:1": "Not by mere enunciation, ",
  "dhp262:2": "or a beautiful complexion ",
  "dhp262:3": "does a person become holy, ",
  "dhp262:4": "if they’re jealous, stingy, and devious. ",
  "dhp263:1": "But if they’ve cut that out, ",
  "dhp263:2": "dug it up at the root, eradicated it, ",
  "dhp263:3": "that intelligent one, purged of vice, ",
  "dhp263:4": "is said to be holy. ",
  "dhp264:0": "",
  "dhp264:1": "A liar and breaker of vows is no ascetic ",
  "dhp264:2": "just because they shave their head. ",
  "dhp264:3": "How on earth can one be an ascetic ",
  "dhp264:4": "who’s full of desire and greed? ",
  "dhp265:1": "One who stops all wicked deeds, ",
  "dhp265:2": "great and small, ",
  "dhp265:3": "because of stopping wicked deeds ",
  "dhp265:4": "is said to be an ascetic. ",
  "dhp266:0": "",
  "dhp266:1": "You don’t become a mendicant ",
  "dhp266:2": "just by begging from others. ",
  "dhp266:3": "One who has undertaken domestic duties ",
  "dhp266:4": "has not yet become a mendicant. ",
  "dhp267:1": "But one living a spiritual life, ",
  "dhp267:2": "who has banished both merit and evil, ",
  "dhp267:3": "who wanders having appraised the world, ",
  "dhp267:4": "is said to be a mendicant. ",
  "dhp268:0": "",
  "dhp268:1": "You don’t become a sage by being sagelike, ",
  "dhp268:2": "while still confused and ignorant. ",
  "dhp268:3": "The astute one who holds the scales, ",
  "dhp268:4": "taking only the best, ",
  "dhp269:1": "and shunning the bad—",
  "dhp269:2": "that is a sage, <j>and that is how one becomes a sage. ",
  "dhp269:3": "One who sagely weighs both in the world, ",
  "dhp269:4": "is thereby said to be a sage. ",
  "dhp270:0": "",
  "dhp270:1": "You don’t become a noble one ",
  "dhp270:2": "by harming living beings. ",
  "dhp270:3": "One harmless toward all living beings ",
  "dhp270:4": "is said to be a noble one. ",
  "dhp271:0": "",
  "dhp271:1": "Not by precepts and observances, ",
  "dhp271:2": "nor by much learning, ",
  "dhp271:3": "nor by meditative immersion, ",
  "dhp271:4": "nor by living in seclusion, ",
  "dhp272:1": "do I experience the bliss of renunciation ",
  "dhp272:2": "not frequented by ordinary people. ",
  "dhp272:3": "A mendicant cannot rest confident ",
  "dhp272:4": "without attaining the end of defilements. ",
  "dhp272:5": ""
}

dhp273-289_translation-en-sujato.json.content: { "dhp273:0.1": "Minor Collection ", "dhp273:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 273–289 ", "dhp273:0.3": "20. The Path ", "dhp273:0.4": "", "dhp273:1": "Of paths, the eightfold is the best; ", "dhp273:2": "of truths, the four statements; ", "dhp273:3": "dispassion is the best of things, ", "dhp273:4": "and the Clear-eyed One is the best of humans. ", "dhp274:1": "This is the path, there is no other ", "dhp274:2": "for the purification of vision. ", "dhp274:3": "You all must practice this, ", "dhp274:4": "it is the way to baffle Māra. ", "dhp275:1": "When you all are practicing this, ", "dhp275:2": "you’ll make an end of suffering. ", "dhp275:3": "I have explained the path to you ", "dhp275:4": "for extracting the thorn with wisdom. ", "dhp276:1": "You yourselves must do the work, ", "dhp276:2": "the Realized Ones just show the way. ", "dhp276:3": "Meditators practicing absorption ", "dhp276:4": "are released from Māra’s bonds. ", "dhp277:0": "", "dhp277:1": "All conditions are impermanent—", "dhp277:2": "when this is seen with wisdom, ", "dhp277:3": "one grows disillusioned with suffering: ", "dhp277:4": "this is the path to purity. ", "dhp278:0": "", "dhp278:1": "All conditions are suffering—", "dhp278:2": "when this is seen with wisdom, ", "dhp278:3": "one grows disillusioned with suffering: ", "dhp278:4": "this is the path to purity. ", "dhp279:0": "", "dhp279:1": "All things are not-self—", "dhp279:2": "when this is seen with wisdom, ", "dhp279:3": "one grows disillusioned with suffering: ", "dhp279:4": "this is the path to purity. ", "dhp280:0": "", "dhp280:1": "They don’t get going when it’s time to start; ", "dhp280:2": "they’re young and strong, but given to sloth. ", "dhp280:3": "Their mind depressed in sunken thought, ", "dhp280:4": "lazy and slothful, they can’t discern the path. ", "dhp281:0": "", "dhp281:1": "Guarded in speech, restrained in mind, ", "dhp281:2": "doing no unskillful bodily deed. ", "dhp281:3": "Purify these three ways of performing deeds, ", "dhp281:4": "and win the path known to seers. ", "dhp282:0": "", "dhp282:1": "From meditation springs wisdom, ", "dhp282:2": "without meditation, wisdom ends. ", "dhp282:3": "Knowing these two paths—", "dhp282:4": "of progress and decline—", "dhp282:5": "you should conduct yourself ", "dhp282:6": "so that wisdom grows. ", "dhp283:0": "", "dhp283:1": "Cut down the jungle, not just a tree; ", "dhp283:2": "from the jungle springs fear. ", "dhp283:3": "Having cut down jungle and snarl, ", "dhp283:4": "be free of jungles, mendicants! ", "dhp284:1": "So long as the vine, no matter how small, ", "dhp284:2": "that ties a man to women is not cut, ", "dhp284:3": "his mind remains trapped, ", "dhp284:4": "like a calf suckling its mother. ", "dhp285:0": "", "dhp285:1": "Cut out affection for oneself, ", "dhp285:2": "like plucking an autumn lotus. ", "dhp285:3": "Foster only the path to peace, ", "dhp285:4": "the extinguishment the Holy One taught. ", "dhp286:0": "", "dhp286:1": "“Here I will stay for the rains; ", "dhp286:2": "here for winter, here the summer”; ", "dhp286:3": "thus the fool thinks, ", "dhp286:4": "not realizing the danger. ", "dhp287:0": "", "dhp287:1": "As a mighty flood sweeps away a sleeping village, ", "dhp287:2": "death steals away a man ", "dhp287:3": "who dotes on children and cattle, ", "dhp287:4": "his mind caught up in them. ", "dhp288:0": "", "dhp288:1": "Children provide you no shelter, ", "dhp288:2": "nor does father, nor relatives. ", "dhp288:3": "When you’re seized by the terminator, ", "dhp288:4": "there’s no shelter in family. ", "dhp289:1": "Knowing the reason for this, ", "dhp289:2": "astute, and ethically restrained, ", "dhp289:3": "one would quickly clear the path ", "dhp289:4": "that leads to extinguishment. dhp290-305_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp290:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp290:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 290–305 ",
  "dhp290:0.3": "21. Miscellaneous ",
  "dhp290:0.4": "",
  "dhp290:1": "If by giving up material happiness ",
  "dhp290:2": "one sees abundant happiness, ",
  "dhp290:3": "the attentive would give up material happiness, ",
  "dhp290:4": "seeing the abundant happiness. ",
  "dhp291:0": "",
  "dhp291:1": "Seeking their own happiness ",
  "dhp291:2": "by imposing suffering on others, ",
  "dhp291:3": "intimate with enmity, ",
  "dhp291:4": "they’re not freed from enmity. ",
  "dhp292:0": "",
  "dhp292:1": "They dump what should be done, ",
  "dhp292:2": "and do what should not be done. ",
  "dhp292:3": "For the insolent and the negligent, ",
  "dhp292:4": "their defilements only grow. ",
  "dhp293:1": "Those that have properly undertaken ",
  "dhp293:2": "constant mindfulness of the body, ",
  "dhp293:3": "don’t cultivate what should not be done, ",
  "dhp293:4": "but always do what should be done. ",
  "dhp293:5": "Mindful and aware, ",
  "dhp293:6": "their defilements come to an end. ",
  "dhp294:0": "",
  "dhp294:1": "Having slain mother and father, ",
  "dhp294:2": "and two aristocratic kings, ",
  "dhp294:3": "and having wiped out <j>the kingdom with its tax collector, ",
  "dhp294:4": "the brahmin walks on untroubled. ",
  "dhp295:1": "Having slain mother and father, ",
  "dhp295:2": "and two prosperous kings, ",
  "dhp295:3": "and a tiger as the fifth, ",
  "dhp295:4": "the brahmin walks on untroubled. ",
  "dhp296:0": "",
  "dhp296:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp296:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp296:3": "who day and night ",
  "dhp296:4": "constantly recollect the Buddha. ",
  "dhp297:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp297:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp297:3": "who day and night ",
  "dhp297:4": "constantly recollect the teaching. ",
  "dhp298:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp298:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp298:3": "who day and night ",
  "dhp298:4": "constantly recollect the Saṅgha. ",
  "dhp299:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp299:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp299:3": "who day and night ",
  "dhp299:4": "are constantly mindful of the body. ",
  "dhp300:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp300:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp300:3": "whose minds day and night ",
  "dhp300:4": "delight in harmlessness. ",
  "dhp301:1": "The disciples of Gotama ",
  "dhp301:2": "always wake up refreshed, ",
  "dhp301:3": "whose minds day and night ",
  "dhp301:4": "delight in meditation. ",
  "dhp302:0": "",
  "dhp302:1": "Going forth is hard, it’s hard to be happy; ",
  "dhp302:2": "life at home is hard too, and painful, ",
  "dhp302:3": "it’s painful to stay when you’ve nothing in common. ",
  "dhp302:4": "A traveler is a prey to pain, ",
  "dhp302:5": "so don’t be a traveler, ",
  "dhp302:6": "don’t be prey to pain. ",
  "dhp303:0": "",
  "dhp303:1": "One who is faithful, accomplished in ethics, ",
  "dhp303:2": "blessed with fame and wealth, ",
  "dhp303:3": "is honored in whatever place ",
  "dhp303:4": "they frequent. ",
  "dhp304:0": "",
  "dhp304:1": "The good shine from afar, ",
  "dhp304:2": "like the Himalayan peaks, ",
  "dhp304:3": "but the wicked are not seen, ",
  "dhp304:4": "like arrows scattered in the night. ",
  "dhp305:0": "",
  "dhp305:1": "Sitting alone, sleeping alone, ",
  "dhp305:2": "tirelessly wandering alone; ",
  "dhp305:3": "one who tames themselves alone ",

dhp306-319_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp306:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp306:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 306–319 ",
  "dhp306:0.3": "22. Hell ",
  "dhp306:0.4": "",
  "dhp306:1": "A liar goes to hell, ",
  "dhp306:2": "as does one who denies what they did. ",
  "dhp306:3": "Both are equal in the hereafter, ",
  "dhp306:4": "those men of base deeds. ",
  "dhp307:0": "",
  "dhp307:1": "Many who wear a scrap of ocher cloth ",
  "dhp307:2": "are unrestrained and wicked. ",
  "dhp307:3": "Being wicked, they are reborn in hell ",
  "dhp307:4": "due to their bad deeds. ",
  "dhp308:0": "",
  "dhp308:1": "It’d be better for the immoral and unrestrained ",
  "dhp308:2": "to eat an iron ball, ",
  "dhp308:3": "scorching, like a burning flame, ",
  "dhp308:4": "than to eat the nation’s alms. ",
  "dhp309:0": "",
  "dhp309:1": "Four things befall a heedless man ",
  "dhp309:2": "who sleeps with another’s wife: ",
  "dhp309:3": "wickedness, poor sleep, ",
  "dhp309:4": "ill-repute, and rebirth in hell. ",
  "dhp310:1": "He accrues wickedness and is reborn in a bad place, ",
  "dhp310:2": "all so a frightened couple <j>may snatch a moment’s pleasure, ",
  "dhp310:3": "for which rulers impose a heavy punishment. ",
  "dhp310:4": "That’s why a man should not <j>sleep with another’s wife. ",
  "dhp311:0": "",
  "dhp311:1": "When kusa grass is wrongly grasped ",
  "dhp311:2": "it only cuts the hand. ",
  "dhp311:3": "So too, the ascetic life, when wrongly taken, ",
  "dhp311:4": "drags you to hell. ",
  "dhp312:1": "Any lax act, ",
  "dhp312:2": "any corrupt observance, ",
  "dhp312:3": "or suspicious spiritual life, ",
  "dhp312:4": "is not very fruitful. ",
  "dhp313:1": "If one is to do what should be done, ",
  "dhp313:2": "one should staunchly strive. ",
  "dhp313:3": "For the life gone forth when laxly led ",
  "dhp313:4": "just stirs up dust all the more. ",
  "dhp314:0": "",
  "dhp314:1": "A bad deed is better left undone, ",
  "dhp314:2": "for it will plague you later on. ",
  "dhp314:3": "A good deed is better done, ",
  "dhp314:4": "one that does not plague you. ",
  "dhp315:0": "",
  "dhp315:1": "As a frontier city ",
  "dhp315:2": "is guarded inside and out, ",
  "dhp315:3": "so you should ward yourselves—",
  "dhp315:4": "don’t let the moment pass you by. ",
  "dhp315:5": "For if you miss your moment ",
  "dhp315:6": "you’ll grieve when sent to hell. ",
  "dhp316:0": "",
  "dhp316:1": "Unashamed of what is shameful, ",
  "dhp316:2": "ashamed of what is not shameful; ",
  "dhp316:3": "beings who uphold wrong view ",
  "dhp316:4": "go to a bad place. ",
  "dhp317:1": "Seeing danger where there is none, ",
  "dhp317:2": "and blind to the actual danger, ",
  "dhp317:3": "beings who uphold wrong view ",
  "dhp317:4": "go to a bad place. ",
  "dhp318:0": "",
  "dhp318:1": "Seeing fault where there is none, ",
  "dhp318:2": "and blind to the actual fault, ",
  "dhp318:3": "beings who uphold wrong view ",
  "dhp318:4": "go to a bad place. ",
  "dhp319:1": "Knowing a fault as a fault ",
  "dhp319:2": "and the faultless as faultless, ",
  "dhp319:3": "beings who uphold right view ",
  "dhp319:4": "go to a good place. ",
  "dhp319:5": ""
}

dhp320-333_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp320:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp320:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 320–333 ",
  "dhp320:0.3": "23. Elephants ",
  "dhp320:0.4": "",
  "dhp320:1": "Like an elephant struck ",
  "dhp320:2": "with arrows in battle, ",
  "dhp320:3": "I shall endure abuse, ",
  "dhp320:4": "for so many folk are badly behaved. ",
  "dhp321:1": "The well-tamed beast is the one led to the crowd; ",
  "dhp321:2": "the tamed elephant’s the one the king mounts; ",
  "dhp321:3": "the tamed person who endures abuse ",
  "dhp321:4": "is the best of human beings. ",
  "dhp322:1": "Those who have tamed themselves are better ",
  "dhp322:2": "than fine tamed mules, ",
  "dhp322:3": "thoroughbreds from Sindh, ",
  "dhp322:4": "or giant tuskers. ",
  "dhp323:0": "",
  "dhp323:1": "For not on those mounts ",
  "dhp323:2": "would you go to the untrodden place, ",
  "dhp323:3": "whereas, with the help of one <j>whose self is well tamed, ",
  "dhp323:4": "you go there, tamed by the tamed. ",
  "dhp324:0": "",
  "dhp324:1": "The tusker named Dhanapāla ",
  "dhp324:2": "is musky in rut, hard to control. ",
  "dhp324:3": "Bound, he eats not a morsel, ",
  "dhp324:4": "for he misses the elephant forest. ",
  "dhp325:0": "",
  "dhp325:1": "One who gets drowsy from overeating, ",
  "dhp325:2": "fond of sleep, rolling round the bed ",
  "dhp325:3": "like a great hog stuffed with grain: ",
  "dhp325:4": "that dullard returns to the womb again and again. ",
  "dhp326:0": "",
  "dhp326:1": "In the past my mind wandered ",
  "dhp326:2": "how it wished, where it liked, as it pleased. ",
  "dhp326:3": "Now I’ll carefully guide it, ",
  "dhp326:4": "as a trainer with a hook guides a rutting elephant. ",
  "dhp327:0": "",
  "dhp327:1": "Delight in diligence! ",
  "dhp327:2": "Take good care of your mind! ",
  "dhp327:3": "Pull yourself out of this pit, ",
  "dhp327:4": "like an elephant sunk in a bog. ",
  "dhp328:0": "",
  "dhp328:1": "If you find an alert companion, ",
  "dhp328:2": "an attentive friend to live happily together, ",
  "dhp328:3": "then, overcoming all adversities, ",
  "dhp328:4": "wander with them, joyful and mindful. ",
  "dhp329:1": "If you find no alert companion, ",
  "dhp329:2": "no attentive friend to live happily together, ",
  "dhp329:3": "then, like a king who flees his conquered realm, ",
  "dhp329:4": "wander alone like a tusker in the wilds. ",
  "dhp330:1": "It’s better to wander alone, ",
  "dhp330:2": "there’s no fellowship with fools. ",
  "dhp330:3": "Wander alone and do no wrong, ",
  "dhp330:4": "at ease like a tusker in the wilds. ",
  "dhp331:0": "",
  "dhp331:1": "A friend in need is a blessing; ",
  "dhp331:2": "it’s a blessing to be content with whatever; ",
  "dhp331:3": "good deeds are a blessing at the end of life, ",
  "dhp331:4": "and giving up all suffering is a blessing. ",
  "dhp332:1": "In this world it’s a blessing to serve ",
  "dhp332:2": "one’s mother and one’s father. ",
  "dhp332:3": "And it’s a blessing also to serve ",
  "dhp332:4": "ascetics and brahmins. ",
  "dhp333:1": "It’s a blessing to keep precepts until you grow old; ",
  "dhp333:2": "a blessing to be grounded in faith; ",
  "dhp333:3": "the getting of wisdom’s a blessing; ",
  "dhp333:4": "and it’s a blessing to avoid doing wrong. ",
  "dhp333:5": ""
}

dhp33-43_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp33:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp33:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 33–43 ",
  "dhp33:0.3": "3. The Mind ",
  "dhp33:0.4": "",
  "dhp33:1": "The mind quivers and quakes, ",
  "dhp33:2": "hard to guard, hard to curb. ",
  "dhp33:3": "The discerning straighten it out, ",
  "dhp33:4": "like a fletcher an arrow. ",
  "dhp34:1": "Like a fish pulled from the sea ",
  "dhp34:2": "and cast upon the shore, ",
  "dhp34:3": "this mind flounders about, ",
  "dhp34:4": "trying to throw off Māra’s dominion. ",
  "dhp35:0": "",
  "dhp35:1": "Hard to hold back, flighty, ",
  "dhp35:2": "alighting where it will; ",
  "dhp35:3": "it’s good to tame the mind; ",
  "dhp35:4": "a tamed mind leads to bliss. ",
  "dhp36:0": "",
  "dhp36:1": "So hard to see, so subtle, ",
  "dhp36:2": "alighting where it will; ",
  "dhp36:3": "the discerning protect the mind, ",
  "dhp36:4": "a guarded mind leads to bliss. ",
  "dhp37:0": "",
  "dhp37:1": "The mind travels far, wandering alone; ",
  "dhp37:2": "incorporeal, it lies hidden in the heart. ",
  "dhp37:3": "Those who will restrain the mind ",
  "dhp37:4": "are freed from Māra’s bonds. ",
  "dhp38:0": "",
  "dhp38:1": "Those of unsteady mind, ",
  "dhp38:2": "who don’t understand the true teaching, ",
  "dhp38:3": "and whose confidence wavers, ",
  "dhp38:4": "do not perfect their wisdom. ",
  "dhp39:1": "One whose mind is not festering, ",
  "dhp39:2": "whose heart is undamaged, ",
  "dhp39:3": "who’s given up right and wrong, ",
  "dhp39:4": "alert, has nothing to fear. ",
  "dhp40:0": "",
  "dhp40:1": "Knowing this body breaks like a pot, ",
  "dhp40:2": "and fortifying the mind like a citadel, ",
  "dhp40:3": "attack Māra with the sword of wisdom, ",
  "dhp40:4": "guard your conquest, and never settle. ",
  "dhp41:0": "",
  "dhp41:1": "All too soon this body ",
  "dhp41:2": "will lie upon the earth, ",
  "dhp41:3": "bereft of consciousness, ",
  "dhp41:4": "tossed aside like a worthless log. ",
  "dhp42:0": "",
  "dhp42:1": "A wrongly directed mind ",
  "dhp42:2": "would do you more harm ",
  "dhp42:3": "than a hater to the hated, ",
  "dhp42:4": "or an enemy to their foe. ",
  "dhp43:0": "",
  "dhp43:1": "A rightly directed mind ",
  "dhp43:2": "would do you more good ",
  "dhp43:3": "than your mother or father ",
  "dhp43:4": "or any other relative. ",
  "dhp43:5": ""
}

dhp334-359_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp334:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp334:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 334–359 ",
  "dhp334:0.3": "24. Craving ",
  "dhp334:0.4": "",
  "dhp334:1": "When a man lives heedlessly, ",
  "dhp334:2": "craving grows in them like a camel’s foot creeper. ",
  "dhp334:3": "They jump from one thing to the next, like a langur ",
  "dhp334:4": "greedy for fruit in a forest grove. ",
  "dhp335:1": "Whoever is beaten by this wretched craving, ",
  "dhp335:2": "this attachment to the world, ",
  "dhp335:3": "their sorrow grows, ",
  "dhp335:4": "like grass in the rain. ",
  "dhp336:1": "But whoever prevails over this wretched craving, ",
  "dhp336:2": "so hard to get over in the world, ",
  "dhp336:3": "their sorrows fall from them, ",
  "dhp336:4": "like a drop from a lotus-leaf. ",
  "dhp337:1": "I say this to you, good people, ",
  "dhp337:2": "all those who have gathered here: ",
  "dhp337:3": "dig up the root of craving, ",
  "dhp337:4": "as you’d dig up grass in search of roots. ",
  "dhp337:5": "Don’t let Māra break you again and again, ",
  "dhp337:6": "like a stream breaking a reed. ",
  "dhp338:0": "",
  "dhp338:1": "A tree grows back even when cut down, ",
  "dhp338:2": "so long as its roots are strong and undamaged; ",
  "dhp338:3": "suffering springs up again and again, ",
  "dhp338:4": "so long as the tendency to craving is not pulled out. ",
  "dhp339:1": "A person of low views ",
  "dhp339:2": "in whom the thirty-six streams ",
  "dhp339:3": "that flow to pleasure are mighty, ",
  "dhp339:4": "is swept away by lustful thoughts. ",
  "dhp340:1": "The streams flow everywhere; ",
  "dhp340:2": "a weed springs up and remains. ",
  "dhp340:3": "Seeing this weed that has been born, ",
  "dhp340:4": "cut the root with wisdom. ",
  "dhp341:1": "A personage’s joys ",
  "dhp341:2": "flow from senses and cravings. ",
  "dhp341:3": "Seekers of happiness, bent on pleasure, ",
  "dhp341:4": "continue to be reborn and grow old. ",
  "dhp342:1": "People governed by thirst, ",
  "dhp342:2": "crawl about like a trapped rabbit. ",
  "dhp342:3": "Bound and fettered, for a long time ",
  "dhp342:4": "they return to pain time and again. ",
  "dhp343:1": "People governed by thirst, ",
  "dhp343:2": "crawl about like a trapped rabbit. ",
  "dhp343:3": "That’s why one who longs for dispassion ",
  "dhp343:4": "should dispel thirst. ",
  "dhp344:0": "",
  "dhp344:1": "Unsnarled, they set out for the jungle, ",
  "dhp344:2": "then they run right back to the jungle they left behind. ",
  "dhp344:3": "Just look at this individual! ",
  "dhp344:4": "Freed, they run to bondage. ",
  "dhp345:0": "",
  "dhp345:1": "The attentive say that shackle is not strong ",
  "dhp345:2": "that’s made of iron, wood, or knots. ",
  "dhp345:3": "But obsession with jeweled earrings, ",
  "dhp345:4": "concern for your partners and children: ",
  "dhp346:1": "this, say the attentive, is a strong shackle ",
  "dhp346:2": "dragging the indulgent down, hard to escape. ",
  "dhp346:3": "Having cut this one too they go forth, ",
  "dhp346:4": "unconcerned, having given up sensual pleasures. ",
  "dhp347:0": "",
  "dhp347:1": "Besotted by lust they fall into the stream, ",
  "dhp347:2": "like a spider caught in the web she wove. ",
  "dhp347:3": "The attentive proceed, having cut this one too, ",
  "dhp347:4": "unconcerned, having given up all suffering. ",
  "dhp348:0": "",
  "dhp348:1": "Let go of the past, let go of the future, ",
  "dhp348:2": "let go of the present, having gone beyond rebirth. ",
  "dhp348:3": "With your heart freed in every respect, ",
  "dhp348:4": "you’ll not come again to rebirth and old age. ",
  "dhp349:0": "",
  "dhp349:1": "For a personage churned by thoughts, ",
  "dhp349:2": "very lustful, focusing on beauty, ",
  "dhp349:3": "their craving grows and grows, ",
  "dhp349:4": "tying them with a stout bond. ",
  "dhp350:1": "But one who loves to calm their thoughts, ",
  "dhp350:2": "developing perception of ugliness, ever mindful, ",
  "dhp350:3": "will surely eliminate that craving, ",
  "dhp350:4": "cutting off the bonds of Māra. ",
  "dhp351:0": "",
  "dhp351:1": "One who is confident, unafraid, ",
  "dhp351:2": "rid of craving, free of blemish, ",
  "dhp351:3": "having struck down the arrows flying to future lives, ",
  "dhp351:4": "this bag of bones is their last. ",
  "dhp352:1": "Rid of craving, free of grasping, ",
  "dhp352:2": "expert in the definition of terms, ",
  "dhp352:3": "knowing the correct ",
  "dhp352:4": "structure and sequence of syllables, ",
  "dhp352:5": "they are said to be one who bears their final body, ",
  "dhp352:6": "one of great wisdom, a great person. ",
  "dhp353:0": "",
  "dhp353:1": "I am the vanquisher of all, the knower of all, ",
  "dhp353:2": "unsullied in the midst of all things. ",
  "dhp353:3": "I’ve given up all, freed in the ending of craving. ",
  "dhp353:4": "Since I know for myself, whose follower should I be? ",
  "dhp354:0": "",
  "dhp354:1": "The gift of the teaching surmounts all other gifts; ",
  "dhp354:2": "the taste of the teaching surmounts all other tastes; ",
  "dhp354:3": "the joy of the teaching surmounts all other joys; ",
  "dhp354:4": "the ending of craving surmounts all suffering. ",
  "dhp355:0": "",
  "dhp355:1": "Riches ruin a simpleton, ",
  "dhp355:2": "but not a seeker of the far shore. ",
  "dhp355:3": "From craving for wealth, a simpleton ",
  "dhp355:4": "ruins themselves and others. ",
  "dhp356:0": "",
  "dhp356:1": "Weeds are the bane of crops, ",
  "dhp356:2": "but greed is these folk’s bane. ",
  "dhp356:3": "That’s why a gift to one rid of greed ",
  "dhp356:4": "is so very fruitful. ",
  "dhp357:1": "Weeds are the bane of crops, ",
  "dhp357:2": "but hate is these folk’s bane. ",
  "dhp357:3": "That’s why a gift to one rid of hate ",
  "dhp357:4": "is so very fruitful. ",
  "dhp358:1": "Weeds are the bane of crops, ",
  "dhp358:2": "but delusion is these folk’s bane. ",
  "dhp358:3": "That’s why a gift to one rid of delusion ",
  "dhp358:4": "is so very fruitful. ",
  "dhp359:1": "Weeds are the bane of crops, ",
  "dhp359:2": "but desire is these folk’s bane. ",
  "dhp359:3": "That’s why a gift to one rid of desire ",
  "dhp359:4": "is so very fruitful. ",
  "dhp359:5": ""
}

dhp360-382_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp360:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp360:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 360–382 ",
  "dhp360:0.3": "25. Mendicants ",
  "dhp360:0.4": "",
  "dhp360:1": "Restraint of the eye is good; ",
  "dhp360:2": "good is restraint of the ear; ",
  "dhp360:3": "restraint of the nose is good; ",
  "dhp360:4": "good is restraint of the tongue. ",
  "dhp361:1": "Restraint of the body is good; ",
  "dhp361:2": "good is restraint of speech; ",
  "dhp361:3": "restraint of mind is good; ",
  "dhp361:4": "everywhere, restraint is good. ",
  "dhp361:5": "The mendicant restrained everywhere ",
  "dhp361:6": "is released from all suffering. ",
  "dhp362:0": "",
  "dhp362:1": "One restrained in hand and foot, ",
  "dhp362:2": "and in speech, the supreme restraint; ",
  "dhp362:3": "happy inside, serene, ",
  "dhp362:4": "solitary, content, I call a mendicant. ",
  "dhp363:0": "",
  "dhp363:1": "When a mendicant of restrained mouth, ",
  "dhp363:2": "thoughtful in counsel, not restless, ",
  "dhp363:3": "explains the text and its meaning, ",
  "dhp363:4": "their words are sweet. ",
  "dhp364:0": "",
  "dhp364:1": "Delighting in the teaching, enjoying the teaching, ",
  "dhp364:2": "contemplating the teaching, ",
  "dhp364:3": "a mendicant who recollects the teaching ",
  "dhp364:4": "doesn’t fall away from the true teaching. ",
  "dhp365:0": "",
  "dhp365:1": "A well-off mendicant ought not look down ",
  "dhp365:2": "on others, nor should they be envious. ",
  "dhp365:3": "A mendicant who envies others ",
  "dhp365:4": "does not achieve immersion. ",
  "dhp366:1": "If a mendicant is poor in offerings, ",
  "dhp366:2": "the well-to-do ought not look down on them. ",
  "dhp366:3": "For the gods indeed praise them, ",
  "dhp366:4": "who are tireless and pure of livelihood. ",
  "dhp367:0": "",
  "dhp367:1": "One who has no sense of ownership ",
  "dhp367:2": "in the whole realm of name and form, ",
  "dhp367:3": "who does not grieve for that which is not, ",
  "dhp367:4": "is said to be a mendicant. ",
  "dhp368:0": "",
  "dhp368:1": "A mendicant who meditates on love, ",
  "dhp368:2": "devoted to the Buddha’s teaching, ",
  "dhp368:3": "would realize the peaceful state, ",
  "dhp368:4": "the blissful stilling of conditions. ",
  "dhp369:1": "Bail out this boat, mendicant! ",
  "dhp369:2": "When bailed out it will float lightly. ",
  "dhp369:3": "Having cut off desire and hate, ",
  "dhp369:4": "you shall reach extinguishment. ",
  "dhp370:1": "Five to cut, five to drop, ",
  "dhp370:2": "and five more to develop. ",
  "dhp370:3": "When a mendicant slips five chains ",
  "dhp370:4": "they’re said to have crossed the flood. ",
  "dhp371:1": "Practice absorption, don’t be negligent! ",
  "dhp371:2": "Don’t let the mind delight in the senses! ",
  "dhp371:3": "Don’t heedlessly swallow a hot iron ball! ",
  "dhp371:4": "And when it burns, don’t cry, “Oh, the pain!” ",
  "dhp372:1": "No absorption for one without wisdom, ",
  "dhp372:2": "no wisdom for one without absorption. ",
  "dhp372:3": "But one with absorption and wisdom—",
  "dhp372:4": "they have truly drawn near to extinguishment. ",
  "dhp373:1": "A mendicant who enters an empty hut ",
  "dhp373:2": "with mind at peace ",
  "dhp373:3": "finds a superhuman delight ",
  "dhp373:4": "as they rightly discern the Dhamma. ",
  "dhp374:1": "Whenever they are mindful ",
  "dhp374:2": "of the rise and fall of the aggregates, ",
  "dhp374:3": "they feel rapture and joy: ",
  "dhp374:4": "that is freedom from death for one who knows. ",
  "dhp375:1": "This is the very start of the path ",
  "dhp375:2": "for a wise mendicant here: ",
  "dhp375:3": "guarding the senses, contentment, ",
  "dhp375:4": "and restraint in the monastic code. ",
  "dhp376:1": "Mix with spiritual friends, ",
  "dhp376:2": "who are tireless and pure of livelihood. ",
  "dhp376:3": "Share what you have with others, ",
  "dhp376:4": "being skillful in your conduct. ",
  "dhp376:5": "And when you’re full of joy, ",
  "dhp376:6": "you’ll make an end to suffering. ",
  "dhp377:0": "",
  "dhp377:1": "As a jasmine sheds ",
  "dhp377:2": "its withered flowers, ",
  "dhp377:3": "O mendicants, ",
  "dhp377:4": "shed greed and hate. ",
  "dhp378:0": "",
  "dhp378:1": "Calm in body, calm in speech, ",
  "dhp378:2": "peaceful and serene; ",
  "dhp378:3": "a mendicant who’s spat out the world’s bait ",
  "dhp378:4": "is said to be one at peace. ",
  "dhp379:0": "",
  "dhp379:1": "Urge yourself on, ",
  "dhp379:2": "reflect on yourself. ",
  "dhp379:3": "A mendicant self-controlled and mindful ",
  "dhp379:4": "will always dwell in happiness. ",
  "dhp380:1": "Self is indeed the lord of self, ",
  "dhp380:2": "for who else would be one’s lord? ",
  "dhp380:3": "Self is indeed the home of self, ",
  "dhp380:4": "so restrain yourself, ",
  "dhp380:5": "as a merchant his thoroughbred steed. ",
  "dhp381:0": "",
  "dhp381:1": "A monk full of joy ",
  "dhp381:2": "trusting in the Buddha’s teaching, ",
  "dhp381:3": "would realize the peaceful state, ",
  "dhp381:4": "the blissful stilling of conditions. ",
  "dhp382:0": "",
  "dhp382:1": "A young mendicant ",
  "dhp382:2": "devoted to the Buddha’s teaching, ",
  "dhp382:3": "shines upon this world, ",
  "dhp382:4": "like the moon freed from clouds. ",
  "dhp382:5": ""
}

dhp383-423_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp383:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp383:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 383–423 ",
  "dhp383:0.3": "26. Brahmins ",
  "dhp383:0.4": "",
  "dhp383:1": "Cut the stream, striving! ",
  "dhp383:2": "Cast aside sensual pleasures, brahmin. ",
  "dhp383:3": "Knowing the ending of conditions, ",
  "dhp383:4": "know the uncreated, brahmin. ",
  "dhp384:0": "",
  "dhp384:1": "When a brahmin has gone beyond ",
  "dhp384:2": "dualistic phenomena, ",
  "dhp384:3": "then they consciously ",
  "dhp384:4": "make an end of all fetters. ",
  "dhp385:0": "",
  "dhp385:1": "One for whom there is no crossing over ",
  "dhp385:2": "or crossing back, or crossing over and back; ",
  "dhp385:3": "stress-free, detached, ",
  "dhp385:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp386:0": "",
  "dhp386:1": "Absorbed, rid of hopes, ",
  "dhp386:2": "their task completed, without defilements, ",
  "dhp386:3": "arrived at the highest goal: ",
  "dhp386:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp387:0": "",
  "dhp387:1": "The sun blazes by day, ",
  "dhp387:2": "the moon radiates at night, ",
  "dhp387:3": "the aristocrat shines in armor, ",
  "dhp387:4": "and the brahmin shines in absorption. ",
  "dhp387:5": "But all day and all night, ",
  "dhp387:6": "the Buddha blazes with glory. ",
  "dhp388:0": "",
  "dhp388:1": "A brahmin’s so-called <j>since they’ve banished evil, ",
  "dhp388:2": "an ascetic’s so-called <j>since they live a serene life. ",
  "dhp388:3": "One who has renounced all stains ",
  "dhp388:4": "is said to be a “renunciant”. ",
  "dhp389:0": "",
  "dhp389:1": "One should never strike a brahmin, ",
  "dhp389:2": "nor should a brahmin retaliate. ",
  "dhp389:3": "Woe to the one who hurts a brahmin, ",
  "dhp389:4": "and woe for the one who retaliates. ",
  "dhp390:1": "Nothing is better for a brahmin ",
  "dhp390:2": "than to hold their mind back from attachment. ",
  "dhp390:3": "From wherever a cruel wish recoils, ",
  "dhp390:4": "right there suffering subsides. ",
  "dhp391:0": "",
  "dhp391:1": "Who does nothing wrong ",
  "dhp391:2": "by body, speech or mind, ",
  "dhp391:3": "restrained in these three respects, ",
  "dhp391:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp392:0": "",
  "dhp392:1": "You should graciously honor ",
  "dhp392:2": "the one from whom you learn the Dhamma ",
  "dhp392:3": "taught by the awakened Buddha, ",
  "dhp392:4": "as a brahmin honors the sacred flame. ",
  "dhp393:0": "",
  "dhp393:1": "Not by matted hair or family, ",
  "dhp393:2": "or birth is one a brahmin. ",
  "dhp393:3": "Those who are  truthful and principled: ",
  "dhp393:4": "they are pure, they are brahmins. ",
  "dhp394:0": "",
  "dhp394:1": "Why the matted hair, you simpleton, ",
  "dhp394:2": "and why the skin of deer? ",
  "dhp394:3": "The tangle is inside you, ",
  "dhp394:4": "yet you polish up your outsides. ",
  "dhp395:0": "",
  "dhp395:1": "A personage who wears robes of rags, ",
  "dhp395:2": "lean, their limbs showing veins, ",
  "dhp395:3": "meditating alone in the forest, ",
  "dhp395:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp396:0": "",
  "dhp396:1": "I don’t call someone a brahmin ",
  "dhp396:2": "after the mother’s womb they’re born from. ",
  "dhp396:3": "If they still have attachments, ",
  "dhp396:4": "they’re just someone who says “worthy”. ",
  "dhp396:5": "Having nothing, taking nothing: ",
  "dhp396:6": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp397:0": "",
  "dhp397:1": "Having cut off all fetters ",
  "dhp397:2": "they have no anxiety. ",
  "dhp397:3": "They’ve slipped their chains and are detached: ",
  "dhp397:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp398:0": "",
  "dhp398:1": "They’ve cut the strap and harness, ",
  "dhp398:2": "the halter and bridle too, ",
  "dhp398:3": "with cross-bar lifted, they’re awakened: ",
  "dhp398:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp399:0": "",
  "dhp399:1": "Abuse, killing, caging: ",
  "dhp399:2": "they endure these without anger. ",
  "dhp399:3": "Patience is their powerful army: ",
  "dhp399:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp400:0": "",
  "dhp400:1": "Not irritable or pretentious, ",
  "dhp400:2": "dutiful in precepts and observances, ",
  "dhp400:3": "tamed, bearing their final body: ",
  "dhp400:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp401:0": "",
  "dhp401:1": "Like water from a lotus leaf, ",
  "dhp401:2": "like a mustard seed off the point of a pin, ",
  "dhp401:3": "sensual pleasures slip off them: ",
  "dhp401:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp402:0": "",
  "dhp402:1": "They understand for themselves ",
  "dhp402:2": "the end of suffering in this life; ",
  "dhp402:3": "with burden put down, detached: ",
  "dhp402:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp403:0": "",
  "dhp403:1": "Deep in wisdom, intelligent, ",
  "dhp403:2": "expert in the path and what is not the path; ",
  "dhp403:3": "arrived at the highest goal: ",
  "dhp403:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp404:0": "",
  "dhp404:1": "Mixing with neither ",
  "dhp404:2": "householders nor the homeless; ",
  "dhp404:3": "a migrant with no bastion, few in wishes: ",
  "dhp404:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp405:0": "",
  "dhp405:1": "They’ve laid aside violence ",
  "dhp405:2": "against creatures firm and frail; ",
  "dhp405:3": "not killing or making others kill: ",
  "dhp405:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp406:0": "",
  "dhp406:1": "Not fighting among those who fight, ",
  "dhp406:2": "quenched among those who have taken up arms, ",
  "dhp406:3": "not grasping among those who grasp: ",
  "dhp406:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp407:0": "",
  "dhp407:1": "They’ve discarded greed and hate, ",
  "dhp407:2": "along with conceit and contempt, ",
  "dhp407:3": "like a mustard seed off the point of a pin: ",
  "dhp407:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp408:0": "",
  "dhp408:1": "The words they utter ",
  "dhp408:2": "are polished, informative, and true, ",
  "dhp408:3": "and don’t offend anyone: ",
  "dhp408:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp409:0": "",
  "dhp409:1": "They don’t steal anything in the world, ",
  "dhp409:2": "long or short, ",
  "dhp409:3": "tiny or huge, beautiful or ugly: ",
  "dhp409:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp410:0": "",
  "dhp410:1": "They have no hope ",
  "dhp410:2": "in this world or the next; ",
  "dhp410:3": "with no need for hope, detached: ",
  "dhp410:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp411:0": "",
  "dhp411:1": "They have no clinging, ",
  "dhp411:2": "knowledge has freed them of indecision, ",
  "dhp411:3": "they’ve arrived at the objective, freedom from death: ",
  "dhp411:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp412:0": "",
  "dhp412:1": "They’ve escaped the chain ",
  "dhp412:2": "of both good and bad deeds; ",
  "dhp412:3": "sorrowless, stainless, pure: ",
  "dhp412:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp413:0": "",
  "dhp413:1": "Pure as the spotless moon, ",
  "dhp413:2": "clear and unclouded, ",
  "dhp413:3": "they’ve ended relish for rebirth: ",
  "dhp413:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp414:0": "",
  "dhp414:1": "They’ve got past this grueling swamp ",
  "dhp414:2": "of delusion, transmigration. ",
  "dhp414:3": "Meditating in stillness, free of indecision, ",
  "dhp414:4": "they have crossed over to the far shore. ",
  "dhp414:5": "They’re quenched by not grasping: ",
  "dhp414:6": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp415:0": "",
  "dhp415:1": "They’ve given up sensual pleasures, ",
  "dhp415:2": "and have gone forth from lay life; ",
  "dhp415:3": "they’ve ended rebirth in the sensual realm: ",
  "dhp415:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp416:0": "",
  "dhp416:1": "They’ve given up craving, ",
  "dhp416:2": "and have gone forth from lay life; ",
  "dhp416:3": "they’ve ended craving to be reborn: ",
  "dhp416:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp416:5.0": "",
  "dhp416:5.1": "They’ve given up craving, ",
  "dhp416:6": "and have gone forth from lay life; ",
  "dhp416:7": "they’ve ended craving to be reborn: ",
  "dhp416:8": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp417:0": "",
  "dhp417:1": "They’ve thrown off the human yoke, ",
  "dhp417:2": "and slipped out of the heavenly yoke; ",
  "dhp417:3": "unyoked from all yokes: ",
  "dhp417:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp418:0": "",
  "dhp418:1": "Giving up desire and discontent, ",
  "dhp418:2": "they’re cooled and free of attachments; ",
  "dhp418:3": "a hero, master of the whole world: ",
  "dhp418:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp419:0": "",
  "dhp419:1": "They know the passing away ",
  "dhp419:2": "and rebirth of all beings; ",
  "dhp419:3": "unattached, holy, awakened: ",
  "dhp419:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp420:1": "Gods, centaurs, and humans ",
  "dhp420:2": "don’t know their destiny; ",
  "dhp420:3": "the perfected ones with defilements ended: ",
  "dhp420:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp421:0": "",
  "dhp421:1": "They have nothing before or after, ",
  "dhp421:2": "or even in between. ",
  "dhp421:3": "Having nothing, taking nothing: ",
  "dhp421:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp422:0": "",
  "dhp422:1": "Captain of the herd, excellent hero, ",
  "dhp422:2": "great seer and victor; ",
  "dhp422:3": "unstirred, washed, awakened: ",
  "dhp422:4": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
  "dhp423:0": "",
  "dhp423:1": "One who knows their past lives, ",
  "dhp423:2": "sees heaven and places of loss, ",
  "dhp423:3": "and has attained the end of rebirth; ",
  "dhp423:4": "a sage of perfect insight ",
  "dhp423:5": "at the summit of spiritual perfection: ",
  "dhp423:6": "that’s who I declare a brahmin. ",
