dhp44-59_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp44:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp44:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 44–59 ",
  "dhp44:0.3": "4. Flowers ",
  "dhp44:0.4": "",
  "dhp44:1": "Who bestirs this earth, ",
  "dhp44:2": "and the Yama realm with its gods? ",
  "dhp44:3": "Who sets out the well-taught word of truth, ",
  "dhp44:4": "as an expert a flower? ",
  "dhp45:1": "A trainee bestirs this earth, ",
  "dhp45:2": "and the Yama realm with its gods. ",
  "dhp45:3": "A trainee sets out the well-taught word of truth, ",
  "dhp45:4": "as an expert a flower. ",
  "dhp46:0": "",
  "dhp46:1": "Knowing this body’s like foam, ",
  "dhp46:2": "realizing it’s all just a mirage, ",
  "dhp46:3": "and cutting off Māra’s blossoming, ",
  "dhp46:4": "vanish from the King of Death. ",
  "dhp47:0": "",
  "dhp47:1": "As a mighty flood sweeps off a sleeping village, ",
  "dhp47:2": "death steals away a man ",
  "dhp47:3": "even as he gathers flowers, ",
  "dhp47:4": "his mind caught up in them. ",
  "dhp48:0": "",
  "dhp48:1": "The terminator gains control of the man ",
  "dhp48:2": "who has not had his fill of pleasures, ",
  "dhp48:3": "even as he gathers flowers, ",
  "dhp48:4": "his mind caught up in them. ",
  "dhp49:0": "",
  "dhp49:1": "A bee takes the nectar ",
  "dhp49:2": "and moves on, doing no damage ",
  "dhp49:3": "to the flower’s beauty and fragrance; ",
  "dhp49:4": "and that’s how a sage should walk in the village. ",
  "dhp50:0": "",
  "dhp50:1": "Don’t find fault with others, ",
  "dhp50:2": "with what they’ve done or left undone. ",
  "dhp50:3": "You should only watch yourself, ",
  "dhp50:4": "what you’ve done or left undone. ",
  "dhp51:0": "",
  "dhp51:1": "Just like a glorious flower ",
  "dhp51:2": "that’s colorful but lacks fragrance; ",
  "dhp51:3": "eloquent speech is fruitless ",
  "dhp51:4": "for one who does not act on it. ",
  "dhp52:1": "Just like a glorious flower ",
  "dhp52:2": "that’s both colorful and fragrant, ",
  "dhp52:3": "eloquent speech is fruitful ",
  "dhp52:4": "for one who acts on it. ",
  "dhp53:0": "",
  "dhp53:1": "Just as one would create many garlands ",
  "dhp53:2": "from a heap of flowers, ",
  "dhp53:3": "when a person has come to be born, ",
  "dhp53:4": "they should do many skillful things. ",
  "dhp54:0": "",
  "dhp54:1": "The fragrance of flowers doesn’t spread upwind, ",
  "dhp54:2": "nor sandalwood, pinwheel, or jasmine; ",
  "dhp54:3": "but the fragrance of the good spreads upwind; ",
  "dhp54:4": "a true person’s virtue spreads in every direction. ",
  "dhp55:1": "Among all the fragrances—",
  "dhp55:2": "sandalwood or pinwheel ",
  "dhp55:3": "or lotus or jasmine—",
  "dhp55:4": "the fragrance of virtue is supreme. ",
  "dhp56:0": "",
  "dhp56:1": "Faint is the fragrance ",
  "dhp56:2": "of sandal or pinwheel; ",
  "dhp56:3": "but the fragrance of the virtuous ",
  "dhp56:4": "floats to the highest gods. ",
  "dhp57:0": "",
  "dhp57:1": "For those accomplished in ethics, ",
  "dhp57:2": "meditating diligently, ",
  "dhp57:3": "freed through the highest knowledge, ",
  "dhp57:4": "Māra cannot find their path. ",
  "dhp58:0": "",
  "dhp58:1": "From a heap of trash ",
  "dhp58:2": "discarded on the highway, ",
  "dhp58:3": "a lotus might blossom, ",
  "dhp58:4": "fragrant and delightful. ",
  "dhp59:1": "So too, among those thought of as trash, ",
  "dhp59:2": "a disciple of the perfect Buddha ",
  "dhp59:3": "outshines with their wisdom ",
  "dhp59:4": "the blind ordinary folk. ",
  "dhp59:5": ""
}

dhp60-75_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp60:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp60:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 60–75 ",
  "dhp60:0.3": "5. The Fool ",
  "dhp60:0.4": "",
  "dhp60:1": "Long is the night for the wakeful; ",
  "dhp60:2": "long is the league for the weary; ",
  "dhp60:3": "long transmigrate the fools ",
  "dhp60:4": "who don’t understand the true teaching. ",
  "dhp61:0": "",
  "dhp61:1": "If while wandering you find no partner ",
  "dhp61:2": "equal or better than yourself, ",
  "dhp61:3": "then firmly resolve to wander alone—",
  "dhp61:4": "there’s no fellowship with fools. ",
  "dhp62:0": "",
  "dhp62:1": "“Sons are mine, wealth is mine”—",
  "dhp62:2": "thus the fool frets. ",
  "dhp62:3": "For even your self is not your own, ",
  "dhp62:4": "let alone your sons or wealth. ",
  "dhp63:0": "",
  "dhp63:1": "The fool who thinks they’re a fool ",
  "dhp63:2": "is wise at least to that extent. ",
  "dhp63:3": "But the true fool is said to be one ",
  "dhp63:4": "who imagines that they are wise. ",
  "dhp64:0": "",
  "dhp64:1": "Though a fool attends to the wise ",
  "dhp64:2": "even for the rest of their life, ",
  "dhp64:3": "they still don’t understand the teaching, ",
  "dhp64:4": "like a spoon the taste of the soup. ",
  "dhp65:0": "",
  "dhp65:1": "If a clever person attends to the wise ",
  "dhp65:2": "even just for an hour or so, ",
  "dhp65:3": "they swiftly understand the teaching, ",
  "dhp65:4": "like a tongue the taste of the soup. ",
  "dhp66:0": "",
  "dhp66:1": "Fools and simpletons behave ",
  "dhp66:2": "like their own worst enemies, ",
  "dhp66:3": "doing wicked deeds ",
  "dhp66:4": "that ripen as bitter fruit. ",
  "dhp67:0": "",
  "dhp67:1": "It’s not good to do a deed ",
  "dhp67:2": "that plagues you later on, ",
  "dhp67:3": "for which you weep and wail, ",
  "dhp67:4": "as its effect stays with you. ",
  "dhp68:0": "",
  "dhp68:1": "It is good to do a deed ",
  "dhp68:2": "that doesn’t plague you later on, ",
  "dhp68:3": "that gladdens and cheers, ",
  "dhp68:4": "as its effect stays with you. ",
  "dhp69:0": "",
  "dhp69:1": "The fool imagines that evil is sweet, ",
  "dhp69:2": "so long as it has not yet ripened. ",
  "dhp69:3": "But as soon as that evil ripens, ",
  "dhp69:4": "they fall into suffering. ",
  "dhp70:0": "",
  "dhp70:1": "Month after month a fool may eat ",
  "dhp70:2": "food from a grass-blade’s tip; ",
  "dhp70:3": "but they’ll never be worth a sixteenth part ",
  "dhp70:4": "of one who has appraised the teaching. ",
  "dhp71:0": "",
  "dhp71:1": "For a wicked deed that has been done ",
  "dhp71:2": "does not curdle quickly like milk. ",
  "dhp71:3": "Smoldering, it follows the fool, ",
  "dhp71:4": "like a fire smothered over with ash. ",
  "dhp72:0": "",
  "dhp72:1": "Whatever fame a fool may get, ",
  "dhp72:2": "it only gives rise to harm. ",
  "dhp72:3": "Whatever good features they have it ruins, ",
  "dhp72:4": "and blows their head into bits. ",
  "dhp73:0": "",
  "dhp73:1": "They’d seek the esteem that they lack, ",
  "dhp73:2": "and status among the mendicants; ",
  "dhp73:3": "authority over monasteries, ",
  "dhp73:4": "and honor among other families. ",
  "dhp74:1": "“Let both layfolk and renunciants think ",
  "dhp74:2": "the work was done by me alone. ",
  "dhp74:3": "In anything at all that’s to be done, ",
  "dhp74:4": "let them fall under my sway alone.” ",
  "dhp74:5": "So thinks the fool, ",
  "dhp74:6": "their greed and pride only growing. ",
  "dhp75:0": "",
  "dhp75:1": "For the means to profit and the path to quenching ",
  "dhp75:2": "are two quite different things. ",
  "dhp75:3": "A mendicant disciple of the Buddha, ",
  "dhp75:4": "understanding what this really means, ",
  "dhp75:5": "would never delight in honors, ",
  "dhp75:6": "but rather would foster seclusion. ",
  "dhp75:7": ""
}

dhp76-89_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp76:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp76:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 76–89 ",
  "dhp76:0.3": "6. The Astute ",
  "dhp76:0.4": "",
  "dhp76:1": "Regard one who sees your faults ",
  "dhp76:2": "as a guide to a hidden treasure. ",
  "dhp76:3": "Stay close to one so intelligent and astute ",
  "dhp76:4": "who curbs you when you need it. ",
  "dhp76:5": "Sticking close to such an impartial person, ",
  "dhp76:6": "things get better, not worse. ",
  "dhp77:0": "",
  "dhp77:1": "Advise and instruct; ",
  "dhp77:2": "curb wickedness: ",
  "dhp77:3": "for you shall be loved by the good, ",
  "dhp77:4": "and disliked by the bad. ",
  "dhp78:0": "",
  "dhp78:1": "Don’t mix with bad friends, ",
  "dhp78:2": "nor with the worst of men. ",
  "dhp78:3": "Mix with spiritual friends, ",
  "dhp78:4": "and with the best of men. ",
  "dhp79:0": "",
  "dhp79:1": "Through joy in the teaching you sleep at ease, ",
  "dhp79:2": "with clear and confident heart. ",
  "dhp79:3": "An astute person always delights in the teaching ",
  "dhp79:4": "proclaimed by the Noble One. ",
  "dhp80:0": "",
  "dhp80:1": "While irrigators guide water, ",
  "dhp80:2": "fletchers bend arrows straight, ",
  "dhp80:3": "and carpenters bend timber straight, ",
  "dhp80:4": "the astute tame themselves. ",
  "dhp81:0": "",
  "dhp81:1": "As the wind cannot stir ",
  "dhp81:2": "a solid mass of rock, ",
  "dhp81:3": "so too blame and praise ",
  "dhp81:4": "do not affect the wise. ",
  "dhp82:0": "",
  "dhp82:1": "Like a deep lake, ",
  "dhp82:2": "clear and unclouded, ",
  "dhp82:3": "so clear are the astute ",
  "dhp82:4": "when they hear the teachings. ",
  "dhp83:0": "",
  "dhp83:1": "True persons give up everything, ",
  "dhp83:2": "they don’t cajole for the things they desire. ",
  "dhp83:3": "Though touched by sadness or happiness, ",
  "dhp83:4": "the astute appear neither depressed nor elated. ",
  "dhp84:0": "",
  "dhp84:1": "Never wish for success by unjust means, ",
  "dhp84:2": "for your own sake or that of another, ",
  "dhp84:3": "desiring children, wealth, or nation; ",
  "dhp84:4": "rather, be virtuous, wise, and just. ",
  "dhp85:0": "",
  "dhp85:1": "Few are those among humans ",
  "dhp85:2": "who cross to the far shore. ",
  "dhp85:3": "The rest just run around ",
  "dhp85:4": "on the near shore. ",
  "dhp86:1": "When the teaching is well explained, ",
  "dhp86:2": "the people who practice accordingly ",
  "dhp86:3": "will cross over ",
  "dhp86:4": "Death’s dominion so hard to pass. ",
  "dhp87:0": "",
  "dhp87:1": "Rid of dark qualities, ",
  "dhp87:2": "an astute person would develop the bright. ",
  "dhp87:3": "Having left home for homelessness ",
  "dhp87:4": "in seclusion, where joy is hard, ",
  "dhp88:1": "they’d long for satisfaction there. ",
  "dhp88:2": "Forsaking sensual pleasures, owning nothing, ",
  "dhp88:3": "an astute person would cleanse themselves ",
  "dhp88:4": "of mental corruptions. ",
  "dhp89:1": "And those whose minds are rightly developed ",
  "dhp89:2": "in the awakening factors; ",
  "dhp89:3": "who, letting go of attachments, ",
  "dhp89:4": "delight in not grasping: ",
  "dhp89:5": "with defilements ended, brilliant, ",
  "dhp89:6": "they are quenched in this world. ",
  "dhp89:7": ""
}

dhp90-99_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "dhp90:0.1": "Minor Collection ",
  "dhp90:0.2": "Sayings of the Dhamma 90–99 ",
  "dhp90:0.3": "7. The Perfected Ones ",
  "dhp90:0.4": "",
  "dhp90:1": "At journey’s end, rid of sorrow; ",
  "dhp90:2": "everywhere free, ",
  "dhp90:3": "all ties given up, ",
  "dhp90:4": "no fever is found in them. ",
  "dhp91:0": "",
  "dhp91:1": "The mindful apply themselves; ",
  "dhp91:2": "they delight in no abode. ",
  "dhp91:3": "Like a swan gone from the marsh, ",
  "dhp91:4": "they leave home after home behind. ",
  "dhp92:0": "",
  "dhp92:1": "Those with nothing stored up, ",
  "dhp92:2": "who have understood their food, ",
  "dhp92:3": "whose domain is the liberation ",
  "dhp92:4": "of the signless and the empty: ",
  "dhp92:5": "their path is hard to trace, ",
  "dhp92:6": "like birds in the sky. ",
  "dhp93:0": "",
  "dhp93:1": "One whose defilements have ended; ",
  "dhp93:2": "who’s not attached to food; ",
  "dhp93:3": "whose domain is the liberation ",
  "dhp93:4": "of the signless and the empty: ",
  "dhp93:5": "their track is hard to trace, ",
  "dhp93:6": "like birds in the sky. ",
  "dhp94:0": "",
  "dhp94:1": "Whose faculties have become serene, ",
  "dhp94:2": "like horses tamed by a charioteer, ",
  "dhp94:3": "who has abandoned conceit and defilements; ",
  "dhp94:4": "the unaffected one is envied by even the gods. ",
  "dhp95:0": "",
  "dhp95:1": "Undisturbed like the earth, ",
  "dhp95:2": "true to their vows, steady as Indra’s pillar, ",
  "dhp95:3": "like a lake clear of mud; ",
  "dhp95:4": "such a one does not transmigrate. ",
  "dhp96:0": "",
  "dhp96:1": "Their mind is peaceful, ",
  "dhp96:2": "peaceful are their speech and deeds. ",
  "dhp96:3": "Such a one is at peace, ",
  "dhp96:4": "rightly freed through enlightenment. ",
  "dhp97:0": "",
  "dhp97:1": "Lacking faith, a house-breaker, ",
  "dhp97:2": "one who acknowledges nothing, ",
  "dhp97:3": "purged of hope, they’ve wasted their chance: ",
  "dhp97:4": "that is indeed the supreme person! ",
  "dhp98:0": "",
  "dhp98:1": "Whether in village or wilderness, ",
  "dhp98:2": "in a valley or the uplands, ",
  "dhp98:3": "wherever the perfected ones live ",
  "dhp98:4": "is a delightful place. ",
  "dhp99:0": "",
  "dhp99:1": "Delightful are the wildernesses ",
  "dhp99:2": "where no people delight. ",
  "dhp99:3": "Those free of greed will delight there, ",
  "dhp99:4": "not those who seek sensual pleasures. ",
  "dhp99:5": ""
}

snp1.8_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "snp1.8:0.1": "Anthology of Discourses 1.8 ",
  "snp1.8:0.2": "The Discourse on Love ",
  "snp1.8:1.1": "Those who are skilled in the meaning of scripture ",
  "snp1.8:1.2": "should practice as follows <j>to realize the state of peace. ",
  "snp1.8:1.3": "Let them be capable and upright, very upright, ",
  "snp1.8:1.4": "easy to speak to, gentle and humble; ",
  "snp1.8:2.1": "content and unburdensome, ",
  "snp1.8:2.2": "unbusied, living lightly, ",
  "snp1.8:2.3": "alert, with senses calmed, ",
  "snp1.8:2.4": "courteous, not fawning on families. ",
  "snp1.8:3.1": "Let them not do the slightest thing ",
  "snp1.8:3.2": "that others who are wise would blame. ",
  "snp1.8:3.3": "May they be happy and safe! ",
  "snp1.8:3.4": "May all beings be happy! ",
  "snp1.8:4.1": "Whatever living creatures there are ",
  "snp1.8:4.2": "with not a one left out—",
  "snp1.8:4.3": "frail or firm, long or large, ",
  "snp1.8:4.4": "medium, small, tiny or round, ",
  "snp1.8:5.1": "seen or unseen, ",
  "snp1.8:5.2": "living far or near, ",
  "snp1.8:5.3": "those who have been born <j>and those about to be born—",
  "snp1.8:5.4": "may all beings be happy! ",
  "snp1.8:6.1": "Let none deceive another, ",
  "snp1.8:6.2": "nor look down on anyone anywhere. ",
  "snp1.8:6.3": "Though provoked or aggrieved, ",
  "snp1.8:6.4": "let them not wish pain on each other. ",
  "snp1.8:7.1": "Even as a mother would protect with her life ",
  "snp1.8:7.2": "her child, her only child, ",
  "snp1.8:7.3": "so too for all creatures ",
  "snp1.8:7.4": "unfold a boundless heart. ",
  "snp1.8:8.1": "With love for the whole world, ",
  "snp1.8:8.2": "unfold a boundless heart: ",
  "snp1.8:8.3": "above, below, all round, ",
  "snp1.8:8.4": "unconstricted, without enmity or foe. ",
  "snp1.8:9.1": "When standing, walking, sitting, ",
  "snp1.8:9.2": "or lying down while yet unweary, ",
  "snp1.8:9.3": "keep this ever in mind; ",
  "snp1.8:9.4": "for this, they say, is a divine meditation <j>in this life. ",
  "snp1.8:10.1": "Avoiding harmful views, ",
  "snp1.8:10.2": "virtuous, accomplished in insight, ",
  "snp1.8:10.3": "with desire for sensual pleasures dispelled, ",
  "snp1.8:10.4": "they never return to a womb again. ",
  "snp1.8:10.5": ""
}

snp2.4_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "snp2.4:0.1": "Anthology of Discourses 2.4 ",
  "snp2.4:0.2": "Blessings ",
  "snp2.4:1.1": "So I have heard. ",
  "snp2.4:1.2": "At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery. ",
  "snp2.4:1.3": "Then, late at night, a glorious deity, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, went up to the Buddha, bowed, and stood to one side. ",
  "snp2.4:1.4": "That deity addressed the Buddha in verse: ",
  "snp2.4:2.1": "“Many gods and humans ",
  "snp2.4:2.2": "have thought about blessings ",
  "snp2.4:2.3": "desiring well-being: ",
  "snp2.4:2.4": "declare the highest blessing.” ",
  "snp2.4:3.1": "“Not to fraternize with fools, ",
  "snp2.4:3.2": "but to fraternize with the wise, ",
  "snp2.4:3.3": "and honoring those worthy of honor: ",
  "snp2.4:3.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:4.1": "Living in a suitable region, ",
  "snp2.4:4.2": "having made merit in the past, ",
  "snp2.4:4.3": "being rightly resolved in oneself, ",
  "snp2.4:4.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:5.1": "Education and a craft, ",
  "snp2.4:5.2": "discipline and training, ",
  "snp2.4:5.3": "and well-spoken speech: ",
  "snp2.4:5.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:6.1": "Caring for mother and father, ",
  "snp2.4:6.2": "kindness to children and partners, ",
  "snp2.4:6.3": "and unstressful work: ",
  "snp2.4:6.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:7.1": "Giving and righteous conduct, ",
  "snp2.4:7.2": "kindness to relatives, ",
  "snp2.4:7.3": "blameless deeds: ",
  "snp2.4:7.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:8.1": "Desisting and abstaining from evil, ",
  "snp2.4:8.2": "avoiding drinking liquor, ",
  "snp2.4:8.3": "diligence in good qualities: ",
  "snp2.4:8.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:9.1": "Respect and placidity, ",
  "snp2.4:9.2": "contentment and gratitude, ",
  "snp2.4:9.3": "and timely listening to the teaching: ",
  "snp2.4:9.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:10.1": "Patience, being easy to admonish, ",
  "snp2.4:10.2": "the sight of ascetics, ",
  "snp2.4:10.3": "and timely discussion of the teaching: ",
  "snp2.4:10.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:11.1": "Fervor and chastity ",
  "snp2.4:11.2": "seeing the noble truths, ",
  "snp2.4:11.3": "and realization of extinguishment: ",
  "snp2.4:11.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:12.1": "Though touched by worldly conditions, ",
  "snp2.4:12.2": "their mind does not tremble; ",
  "snp2.4:12.3": "sorrowless, stainless, secure: ",
  "snp2.4:12.4": "this is the highest blessing. ",
  "snp2.4:13.1": "Having completed these things, ",
  "snp2.4:13.2": "undefeated everywhere; ",
  "snp2.4:13.3": "everywhere they go in safety: ",
  "snp2.4:13.4": "this is their highest blessing.” ",
  "snp2.4:13.5": ""
}

sn56.11_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "sn56.11:0.1": "Linked Discourses 56.11 ",
  "sn56.11:0.2": "2. Rolling Forth the Wheel of Dhamma ",
  "sn56.11:0.3": "Rolling Forth the Wheel of Dhamma ",
  "sn56.11:1.1": "At one time the Buddha was staying near Varanasi in the deer park at Isipatana. ",
  "sn56.11:1.2": "There the Buddha addressed the group of five mendicants: ",
  "sn56.11:2.1": "“Mendicants, these two extremes should not be cultivated by one gone forth. ",
  "sn56.11:2.2": "What two? ",
  "sn56.11:2.3": "Indulgence in sensual pleasures, which is low, crude, ordinary, ignoble, and pointless. And indulgence in self-mortification, which is painful, ignoble, and pointless. ",
  "sn56.11:2.4": "Avoiding these two extremes, the Realized One understood the middle way of practice, which gives vision and knowledge, and leads to peace, direct knowledge, awakening, and extinguishment. ",
  "sn56.11:3.1": "And what is that middle way of practice? ",
  "sn56.11:3.2": "It is simply this noble eightfold path, that is: ",
  "sn56.11:3.3": "right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion. ",
  "sn56.11:3.4": "This is that middle way of practice, which gives vision and knowledge, and leads to peace, direct knowledge, awakening, and extinguishment. ",
  "sn56.11:4.1": "Now this is the noble truth of suffering. ",
  "sn56.11:4.2": "Rebirth is suffering; old age is suffering; illness is suffering; death is suffering; being coupled with the disliked is suffering; separation from the liked is suffering; not getting what you wish for is suffering. In brief, the five grasping aggregates are suffering. ",
  "sn56.11:4.3": "Now this is the noble truth of the origin of suffering. ",
  "sn56.11:4.4": "It’s the craving that leads to future lives, mixed up with relishing and greed, taking pleasure there wherever it alights. That is, ",
  "sn56.11:4.5": "craving for sensual pleasures, craving for continued existence, and craving for nonexistence. ",
  "sn56.11:4.6": "Now this is the noble truth of the cessation of suffering. ",
  "sn56.11:4.7": "It’s the fading away and cessation of that very same craving no residue left behind; giving it away, letting it go, releasing it, and not clinging to it. ",
  "sn56.11:4.8": "Now this is the noble truth of the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering. ",
  "sn56.11:4.9": "It is simply this noble eightfold path, that is: ",
  "sn56.11:4.10": "right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion. ",
  "sn56.11:5.1": "‘This is the noble truth of suffering.’ Such was the vision, knowledge, wisdom, realization, and light that arose in me regarding teachings not learned before from another. ",
  "sn56.11:5.2": "‘This noble truth of suffering should be completely understood.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:5.3": "‘This noble truth of suffering has been completely understood.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:6.1": "‘This is the noble truth of the origin of suffering.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:6.2": "‘This noble truth of the origin of suffering should be given up.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:6.3": "‘This noble truth of the origin of suffering has been given up.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:7.1": "‘This is the noble truth of the cessation of suffering.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:7.2": "‘This noble truth of the cessation of suffering should be realized.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:7.3": "‘This noble truth of the cessation of suffering has been realized.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:8.1": "‘This is the noble truth of the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:8.2": "‘This noble truth of the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering should be developed.’ Such was the vision that arose in me … ",
  "sn56.11:8.3": "‘This noble truth of the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering has been developed.’ Such was the vision, knowledge, wisdom, realization, and light that arose in me regarding teachings not learned before from another. ",
  "sn56.11:9.1": "As long as my true knowledge and vision about these four noble truths was not fully purified in these three rounds and twelve aspects, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans. ",
  "sn56.11:10.1": "But when my true knowledge and vision about these four noble truths was fully purified in these three rounds and twelve aspects, I announced my supreme perfect awakening in this world with its gods, Māras, and divinities, this population with its ascetics and brahmins, its gods and humans. ",
  "sn56.11:10.2": "Knowledge and vision arose in me: ",
  "sn56.11:10.3": "‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’” ",
  "sn56.11:10.4": "That is what the Buddha said. ",
  "sn56.11:10.5": "Satisfied, the group of five mendicants approved what the Buddha said. ",
  "sn56.11:11.1": "And while this discourse was being spoken, the stainless, immaculate vision of the Dhamma arose in Venerable Koṇḍañña: ",
  "sn56.11:11.2": "“Everything that is liable to arise is liable to cease.” ",
  "sn56.11:12.1": "And when the Buddha rolled forth the Wheel of Dhamma, the earth gods raised the cry: ",
  "sn56.11:12.2": "“Near Varanasi, in the deer park at Isipatana, the Buddha has rolled forth the supreme Wheel of Dhamma. And that wheel cannot be rolled back by any ascetic or brahmin or god or Māra or divinity or by anyone in the world.” ",
  "sn56.11:12.3": "Hearing the cry of the earth gods, the gods of the four great kings … ",
  "sn56.11:12.4": "",
  "sn56.11:12.5": "the gods of the thirty-three … ",
  "sn56.11:12.6": "the gods of Yama … ",
  "sn56.11:12.7": "the joyful gods … ",
  "sn56.11:12.8": "the gods who love to create … ",
  "sn56.11:12.9": "the gods who control what is created by others … ",
  "sn56.11:12.10": "the gods of the Divinity’s host raised the cry: ",
  "sn56.11:12.11": "“Near Varanasi, in the deer park at Isipatana, the Buddha has rolled forth the supreme Wheel of Dhamma. And that wheel cannot be rolled back by any ascetic or brahmin or god or Māra or divinity or by anyone in the world.” ",
  "sn56.11:13.1": "And so at that moment, that second, that hour, the cry soared up to the realm of divinity. ",
  "sn56.11:13.2": "And this ten-thousandfold galaxy shook and rocked and trembled. And an immeasurable, magnificent light appeared in the world, surpassing the glory of the gods. ",
  "sn56.11:14.1": "Then the Buddha expressed this heartfelt sentiment: ",
  "sn56.11:14.2": "“Koṇḍañña has really understood! Koṇḍañña has really understood!” ",
  "sn56.11:14.3": "And that’s how Venerable Koṇḍañña came to be known as “Koṇḍañña Who Understood”. ",
  "sn56.11:14.4": ""
}

an8.41_translation-en-sujato.json.content:
{
  "an8.41:0.1": "Numbered Discourses 8.41 ",
  "an8.41:0.2": "5. Sabbath ",
  "an8.41:0.3": "The Sabbath With Eight Factors, In Brief ",
  "an8.41:1.1": "So I have heard. ",
  "an8.41:1.2": "At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery. ",
  "an8.41:1.3": "There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, ",
  "an8.41:1.4": "“Mendicants!” ",
  "an8.41:1.5": "“Venerable sir,” they replied. ",
  "an8.41:1.6": "The Buddha said this: ",
  "an8.41:2.1": "“Mendicants, the observance of the sabbath with its eight factors is very fruitful and beneficial and brilliant and bountiful. ",
  "an8.41:2.2": "And how should it be observed? ",
  "an8.41:2.3": "It’s when a noble disciple reflects: ",
  "an8.41:2.4": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up killing living creatures, renouncing the rod and the sword. They are scrupulous and kind, and live full of sympathy for all living beings. ",
  "an8.41:2.5": "I, too, for this day and night will give up killing living creatures, renouncing the rod and the sword. I’ll be scrupulous and kind, and live full of sympathy for all living beings. ",
  "an8.41:2.6": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:2.7": "This is its first factor. ",
  "an8.41:3.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up stealing. They take only what’s given, and expect only what’s given. They keep themselves clean by not thieving. ",
  "an8.41:3.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up stealing. I’ll take only what’s given, and expect only what’s given. I’ll keep myself clean by not thieving. ",
  "an8.41:3.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:3.4": "This is its second factor. ",
  "an8.41:4.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up unchastity. They are chaste, set apart, refraining from the vulgar act of sex. ",
  "an8.41:4.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up unchastity. I will be chaste, set apart, refraining from the vulgar act of sex. ",
  "an8.41:4.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:4.4": "This is its third factor. ",
  "an8.41:5.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up lying. They speak the truth and stick to the truth. They’re honest and dependable, and don’t trick the world with their words. ",
  "an8.41:5.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up lying. I’ll speak the truth and stick to the truth. I’ll be honest and dependable, and won’t trick the world with my words. ",
  "an8.41:5.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:5.4": "This is its fourth factor. ",
  "an8.41:6.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor. ",
  "an8.41:6.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor. ",
  "an8.41:6.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:6.4": "This is its fifth factor. ",
  "an8.41:7.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones eat in one part of the day, abstaining from eating at night and from food at the wrong time. ",
  "an8.41:7.2": "I, too, for this day and night will eat in one part of the day, abstaining from eating at night and food at the wrong time. ",
  "an8.41:7.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:7.4": "This is its sixth factor. ",
  "an8.41:8.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up seeing shows of dancing, singing, and music; and attiring and adorning themselves with garlands, fragrance, and makeup. ",
  "an8.41:8.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up seeing shows of dancing, singing, and music; and attiring and adorning myself with garlands, fragrance, and makeup. ",
  "an8.41:8.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:8.4": "This is its seventh factor. ",
  "an8.41:9.1": "‘As long as they live, the perfected ones give up high and luxurious beds. They sleep in a low place, either a cot or a grass mat. ",
  "an8.41:9.2": "I, too, for this day and night will give up high and luxurious beds. I’ll sleep in a low place, either a cot or a grass mat. ",
  "an8.41:9.3": "I will observe the sabbath by doing as the perfected ones do in this respect.’ ",
  "an8.41:9.4": "This is its eighth factor. ",
  "an8.41:10.1": "The observance of the sabbath with its eight factors in this way is very fruitful and beneficial and brilliant and bountiful.” ",
  "an8.41:10.2": ""
}
